title: Customer Service Agent - Shopify Dropshipping Europe
description:
# Customer Service Representative — Shopify Dropshipping 
 Support)



We run multiple Shopify dropshipping stores in Europe and are looking for a reliable Customer Service Representative to join our customer support team.



This is an
 support role. You will handle customer
s, use our templates and workflows, log refunds in Google Sheets, and escalate complex cases when needed.



You MUST already have experience with customer service for dropshipping stores. Experience handling support for multiple stores at the same time is a big advantage.



---



## Main Responsibilities



* Answer customer
s for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Maintain a steady pace of around **20 answered
s per hour**

* Handle order questions, shipping updates, returns, refunds, lost packages, and defective product claims

* Use DeepL to translate Dutch, Polish, and other European customer
s

* Start from the correct pre-written template, but personalize every single reply — customers should never receive an obvious copy-paste answer

* Build and improve your own ChatGPT prompt/template so each
 is written specifically for that customer and their situation

* Handle refund requests using our step-by-step compensation ladder and keep the overall refund percentage as low as possible

* Keep customers calm and satisfied to reduce disputes and escalations

* Log refunds and important cases in Google Sheets

* Check supplier/order information when needed

* Escalate unclear, aggressive, or complex cases through Slack

* Coordinate with another CS team member so work is divided properly



---



## Refunds & Resolution Ladder



Refunds have a direct impact on our margins, so an important part of this role is solving problems properly instead of handing out money by default.



We work with a fixed ladder. You always start at the lowest step:



1. **20% partial refund** — the standard first offer

2. **40% partial refund** — only if the customer declines the first offer and the case justifies it

3. **60% partial refund** — final step, only for serious cases

4. **Return to our supplier in China** — the alternative if the customer does not accept a partial refund



Do not skip steps. Never jump to a higher percentage just because it is faster or easier, and never issue a full refund on your own — those cases go to Slack first.



Every offer must be explained in a friendly, personalized message so the customer feels heard and accepts the solution instead of opening a dispute or chargeback.



---



## Requirements



* Must have experience with CS for Shopify dropshipping stores

* Experience supporting multiple stores is preferred

* Excellent written English

* Strong attention to detail

* Able to follow workflows and templates exactly

* Confident handling refund negotiations and sticking to the compensation ladder

* Able to work at a fast, consistent pace (around 20
s per hour)

* Calm, professional tone with customers

* Comfortable using Gmail, Google Sheets, DeepL, Slack, and ChatGPT

* Comfortable running Hubstaff time tracking during your shifts

* Reliable internet and availability 6 days per week

* Able to work in a coordinated schedule with another CS team member



---



## Performance & Tracking



* We expect around **20
s answered per hour**. With templates, DeepL, and our documented workflows this is very achievable once you know the system.

* Working hours are tracked with **Hubstaff**, which records time and activity during your shift. Hubstaff only runs while you are clocked in on your shift.

* We also look at your **refund rate**: how many cases you manage to resolve at the lowest possible step of the ladder.

* Speed matters, but quality matters too. Wrong or careless replies create disputes, so accuracy comes first.



---



## Languages



You do not need to speak Dutch or other European languages.



We use DeepL, pre-written templates, and documented workflows. You need strong English and the ability to understand the customer issue correctly after translation.



---



## Hours & Compensation



* Part-time to start

* Around 12–18 hours per week

* **Around 2–3 hours per day, 6 days per week**

* More hours possible as workload grows

* **Rate: $4 per hour**

* Payment: weekly via Wise, based on the hours tracked in Hubstaff



The schedule is not fully random/flexible. You will work together with another CS team member, so hours need to be coordinated to avoid overlap and make sure
s are covered properly.



---



## Important



When you start your session, the assigned inbox must be cleared properly. Customer
s should not be left unanswered without a clear reason or escalation.



We are looking for someone reliable, consistent, and long-term.



---



## How To Apply



Please reply with:



1. The word **LIGHTHOUSE** in the subject of your application

2. A short introduction about yourself

3. Your experience with Shopify dropshipping customer service

4. Whether you have handled CS for multiple stores at the same time (include store names / links)

5. Which tools you have used before: Gmail, Shopify, Google Sheets, Slack, DeepL, ChatGPT, Hubstaff, etc.

6. Your time zone and daily availability

7. When you can start

8. A short answer to this question: a customer writes that their product arrived damaged and demands a full refund. How do you handle it?

9. Confirmation that you are comfortable with the $4/hour rate and the 20
s per hour target

10. A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net



Applications without dropshipping CS experience will not be considered.



Looking forward to working together long-term!

title: Roblox Game Scout – Remote | $3,000–$5,000+ Earning Potential
description:
We are a Roblox game studio looking for motivated Roblox Game Scouts to help us discover interesting Roblox games and connect with their developers and owners.



You will use our internal scouting tools to find and review Roblox games, identify opportunities that match our criteria, and reach out to the people behind them.



We provide the tools, training, scouting criteria, and outreach process.



What You'll Do

- Find and review Roblox games using our internal tools

- Identify games that match our scouting criteria

- Research the developers and owners behind these games

- Reach out to developers through Discord or other available channels

- Start conversations with developers who may be interested in selling a share of their game or working with us

- Keep track of games, leads, and conversations in our system

- Pass qualified opportunities to our team



Who We're Looking For



Professional experience is not required. We're mainly looking for people who:



- Know Roblox and regularly play Roblox games

- Understand the Roblox platform and basic terminology

- Have good written English

- Are comfortable reaching out and starting conversations with new people

- Can follow clear instructions and processes

- Are consistent, efficient, and motivated

- Are comfortable doing repetitive scouting and outreach



Experience with Roblox development, Discord communities, game scouting, sales, or outreach is a plus, but not required.



Compensation



We offer a competitive, performance-based compensation structure.



You will receive compensation for every qualified lead you generate, as well as a percentage of the deals we successfully sign.



For someone who works consistently and efficiently, earning $3,000–$5,000+ USD per month is achievable.



Your earnings are directly tied to your performance. The more high-quality opportunities you find and bring to us, the more you can earn. There is significant upside for top-performing scouts who consistently bring us strong Roblox game opportunities.

title: AI-Assisted Full-Stack Builder | Websites, Automations & AI
description:
I am looking for a versatile and resourceful junior AI-assisted builder to support me across several online projects.



This is not a traditional virtual assistant role. You will build real things, including websites, landing pages, Shopify improvements, automations, internal tools and AI-agent workflows.



The work will vary from project to project. You must be flexible, willing to learn new tools and comfortable solving unfamiliar problems.



This is a junior-friendly role. You do not need a computer science degree or years of development experience. I care more about what you can build, how quickly you learn and whether you can deliver reliable, tested work.



WHAT YOU MAY WORK ON



• Building and editing websites and landing pages  

• Creating responsive pages from references or written instructions  

• Improving Shopify stores and product pages  

• Building small internal tools and dashboards  

• Creating automations between tools and services  

• Setting up and improving AI-agent workflows  

• Researching practical technical solutions  

• Finding and fixing bugs in existing projects  

• Testing your work on desktop and mobile  

• Documenting completed work  



TOOLS WE MAY USE



• Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar AI-coding tools  

• HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React  

• Shopify and Liquid  

• GitHub and Vercel  

• APIs, webhooks and automation platforms  

• AI tools and agent frameworks  



You do not need to know every tool already. You do need to be comfortable learning new tools independently.



YOU ARE A GOOD FIT IF YOU



• Have already built projects using AI-coding tools  

• Can show examples of your work  

• Can turn a reference or desired outcome into a working result  

• Are flexible and willing to work across different types of projects  

• Investigate problems before asking for help  

• Communicate clearly when something is blocked or unclear  

• Test your own work before calling it finished  

• Pay attention to design details and mobile responsiveness  

• Follow instructions and documented processes accurately  

• Are honest about what you know and what you still need to learn  

• Want a long-term role with increasing responsibility  



THIS ROLE IS NOT SUITABLE FOR YOU IF YOU



• Only copy and paste AI-generated code without understanding or testing it  

• Need detailed step-by-step instructions for every small decision  

• Regularly miss deadlines without communicating  

• Submit unfinished work as completed  

• Send generic applications without reading the full description  



WORKING ARRANGEMENT



• Part-time, approximately 10 to 20 hours per week  

• Flexible working hours  

• Fully remote  

• Long-term opportunity if we work well together  

• Paid trial project before a longer agreement  

• Starting rate of $4 to $5 per hour, depending on skills and trial results  



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself and your current availability.

2. Links to two or three projects you personally built.

3. A short explanation of what you personally did on each project.

4. The AI-coding tools you use and how you normally use them.

5. An example of a difficult problem you solved independently.

6. Confirmation that the starting rate of $4 to $5 per hour works for you.



Start your application with the words “Flexible Builder” so I know you read the complete job post.



Do not send a generic application. I am looking for someone who can become a reliable long-term builder across multiple projects.

title: Pinterest VA
description:
Versatile Pinterest VA with experience in chatgpt image creation and/or experience in making pins in Canva or picmonkey. 



For 6 years I’ve been creating, administrating, and developing a popular blog that focuses on delivering informative content in a relatable way for busy parents. My main areas of focus are in toddler and preschooler activities and the newborn/baby years.  Since then I've also developed a recipe blog, which shares easy family friendly recipes. 



I’m based in the UK but most of my readers are in the USA, as the majority of my traffic comes from Pinterest



I already employ a Pinterest VA hired through this site and unfortunately she's having to reduce her hours for personal reasons so I'm looking for an additional VA to help with pin creation as well as pin title and description writing.



I am an extremely collaborative, organized, and detail-oriented person. I’m also highly creative and I look forward to working with someone with a flare for design, who understands or is keen to learn Pinterest marketing as well as assist with the minutia of the details necessary to keep a website/business running efficiently.





PINTEREST IMAGE CREATION 



1. Design pin graphics using Canva and CHATGPT

2. Scheduling via Tailwind



PINTEREST PIN TITLE/DESCRIPTION WRITING 

1. KW researching using Pinclicks

2. Writing of pin titles and descriptions using Claude



GENERAL VA DUTIES

1. A wide variety of admin tasks, from one-off projects to ongoing tasks, tbc



You’re right for this job if you might describe yourself as most of the following:



• You are proactive, confident, outgoing and take initiative:

              -You aren’t afraid to speak up and point out potential problems that need attention and may suggest solutions.

              -You feel confident to pitch new ideas for ways to improve current processes

              -You're not afraid to ask questions  in order to understand a task or process

• You are organized, pay close attention to detail, and take extreme pride in your work.

• You are a fast learner and enjoy expanding your own skills, challenging yourself to do things out of your comfort zone, while simultaneously managing more remedial tasks with enthusiasm and excitement.

• You aren't afraid to take on new challenges and learn new programs

• You have a good eye for design.

• You have a good sense of humor!



In addition, you must be fluent in English speaker with exceptional written skills



Technical abilities:



In your application, please include which, if any, of the below you’re familiar with:



• Google Docs

• Trello

• Microsoft Word/Excel

• Pinterest

• Pinclicks

• Instagram, including reels

• Tiktok

• Tailwind

• Canva

• Chatgpt

• Wordpress

• Claude

• Any video editing software



Please state any extra skills that may come in handy and set you apart from the rest



Daily Responsibilities:



This is a part-time job (with room to grow into full-time for the right candidate) with an incredible amount of flexibility. I will entrust you to manage your time and work to a deadline with weekly and/or daily assignments. Some may be ongoing (regular duties you do every week), others will be short and one time only.



Please include the phrase “California Dreamin” somewhere in your application so that I know you have read this entire post.



HOURS & TIME COMMITMENT



This job is a part-time position with an opportunity for full-time employment for the right candidate. 



Salary is negotiable based on experience but I'm looking in the region of $3-4 per hour.



I look forward to hearing from you and getting to know you!

title: Australian Solar & Battery Sales Closer | Experienced Only
description:
Australian Solar & Battery Sales Closer | Experienced Only**



GPG Services is looking for an experienced  Australian Residential Solar & Battery Sales Closer based in the Philippines.



This is not an entry-level position and is not for candidates who have only worked as appointment setters.



We are specifically looking for someone who has already worked on an  Australian solar or battery campaign and has personally closed residential customers.



 What we are looking for



* Minimum 1 to 3+ years experience in Australian residential solar, battery or energy sales

* Proven experience personally closing customers, not simply booking appointments

* Strong understanding of Australian homeowners and Australian sales conversations

* Experience handling qualified or warm leads

* Confident presenting solar and battery solutions

* Strong objection handling and negotiation skills

* Comfortable following up customers until a decision is made

* Experience using CRM systems

* Excellent spoken English

* Professional, confident and natural communication style

* Able to work Australian business hours



Strong candidates should be capable of working towards 2 to 3 closed residential sales per day when sufficient qualified leads are provided**, depending on lead quality and campaign conditions.



Your responsibility



You will manage leads through the sales process, including:



Lead contact ? qualification ? discovery ? solar/battery discussion ? quotation or proposal ? objection handling ? follow-up ? closing ? CRM handover.



We want someone who takes ownership of the sale rather than waiting for someone else to close it.



Experience we highly value



Experience with any of the following is highly regarded:



* Australian residential solar

* Home batteries

* Solar + battery packages

* OpenSolar or similar quoting platforms

* GoHighLevel or other CRMs

* Electricity bill discussions

* Solar proposals

* Finance or payment discussions

* Deposit collection

* Australian customer follow-up



Important



Please do not apply if your solar experience is only appointment setting.



We want candidates who can say:



**"I personally closed Australian residential solar or battery customers."**



To apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years have you worked in Australian solar or battery sales?

2. Which Australian campaigns or companies have you worked with?

3. Were you a setter, closer or full-cycle sales consultant?

4. How many sales did you personally close per week or per month?

5. What was your approximate close rate?

6. Were the leads inbound, warm, outbound or self-generated?

7. Did you sell solar, batteries or both?

8. What CRM and quoting software have you used?

9. What Australian states have you sold into?

title: Lead Generation & Data Research Specialist
description:
Lead Generation & Data Research Specialist

Apollo | ZoomInfo | Web Research | List Building | Data Quality

Company: Purnell & Company, Inc.

Position: Lead Generation & Data Research Specialist

Employment Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote

Schedule: 8

Compensation: $4 - $5 weekly



About the Role

Purnell & Company is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Lead Generation & Data

Research Specialist to support our growing sales and business development operations.

This is not a cold-calling position.

Your primary responsibility will be finding, researching, organizing, verifying, and maintaining

high-quality prospect data that our sales teams can use.

You will work with tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, company websites, federal agency

websites, online directories, and manual web research to build targeted prospect lists based

on specific criteria.

We are looking for someone who enjoys research, works quickly without sacrificing accuracy,

follows processes carefully, and can manage large amounts of data without losing track of

where work stopped.



What You Will Do

Lead Generation & Research

• Build targeted prospect lists based on specific campaign criteria.

• Research companies, organizations, federal agencies, and individual contacts.

• Identify decision-makers based on job title, department, seniority, geography, company

size, and other assigned criteria.

• Find and compile contact information including:

o First and last name

o Company or organization

o Job title

o Business

o Phone number

o LinkedIn profile



Geographic location

o Department or seniority

o Source information

o Other campaign-specific information



Research Using Multiple Sources

You may use:

• Apollo

• ZoomInfo

• Federal agency websites

• Company websites

• Business directories

• LinkedIn

• Manual Google/web research

• Other approved research databases and sources

Some projects will involve high-volume database extraction. Others will require detailed

manual research to locate difficult-to-find contacts.

Data Quality & Accuracy

Generating large numbers of leads is not enough.

You will be responsible for ensuring that the information you collect is accurate, organized, and

usable.



You will:

• Verify that contacts meet assigned targeting criteria.

• Confirm required data fields are completed.

• Spot-check records for accuracy.

• Identify and remove obviously incomplete or unqualified records.

• Maintain consistent formatting.

• Prevent duplicate records whenever possible.

• Flag questionable or uncertain duplicates.

• Avoid repeating research that has already been completed.



Quality is more important than inflating lead counts with bad data.



Daily Workflow

At the beginning of each workday you will:

Review the previous day’s End-of-Day report.

2. Identify the exact project and campaign being worked.

3. Determine where research stopped.

4. Confirm the current targeting criteria.

5. Continue from the previous stopping point instead of starting over.

6. Determine the appropriate research method for the assignment.

7. Establish the day’s production target based on the type and complexity of the project.



During your shift, you will track:

• Leads generated

• Leads verified

• Leads rejected or excluded when applicable

• Current project or source

• Current stopping point

• Research or productivity blockers

• Tool or access issues

• Changes to campaign criteria



Production Expectations

Production requirements depend on the type of assignment.

Current working benchmarks include:



Manual research:

Approximately 500 completed leads during a full production day, depending on the complexity

of the research and number of required fields.



Scalable database or extraction projects:

Approximately 6,000–8,000 records during a full production day, depending on the platform,

targeting criteria, extraction difficulty, and verification requirements.



These are benchmarks—not universal quotas.

We evaluate performance based on a combination of:

• Production volume

• Accuracy

• Data quality

• Duplicate control

• Ability to follow campaign criteria

• Organization

• Workflow continuity



Communication

End-of-Day Reporting

Every workday must end with a clear EOD report.



Your report should show:

Project

• Campaign/project name

• Source

• Targeting criteria

• Agency/company/segment being researched



Production

• Leads generated

• Leads verified or rejected when applicable

• Cumulative totals



Progress

• Starting point

• Ending point

• Remaining work

• Exact starting point for the next work session



Quality

• Duplicate issues

• Missing information

• Data-quality concerns



Blockers

• Platform problems

• Access problems

• Research limitations

• Questions regarding targeting criteria



Your manager should be able to read your EOD report and immediately understand what was

completed, where you stopped, and exactly what should happen next.



You Must Be Comfortable Asking Questions

We do not want someone who blindly produces incorrect data.

You are expected to notify management when:

• Lead criteria are unclear.

• Instructions conflict.

• Required information cannot be located.

• A research platform is unavailable.

• Duplicate rates appear unusually high.

• Production is significantly below expectations.

• Source data appears unreliable.

• An assigned list has been completed.

• You identify a better way to improve speed, accuracy, or quality.



We value people who can follow systems and improve systems.

Ideal Candidate

You may be a strong fit if you:

• Are extremely detail-oriented.

• Enjoy internet research and data collection.

• Can work independently for long periods without losing focus.

• Are comfortable handling thousands of records.

• Understand the importance of clean data.

• Can follow detailed written SOPs.

• Keep accurate notes about your progress.

• Have strong organizational skills.

• Can recognize inconsistencies and questionable data.

• Are comfortable working with changing campaign requirements.

• Communicate problems instead of hiding them.

• Can move quickly while maintaining accuracy.

• Take ownership of completing assignments.



Preferred Experience

Experience with one or more of the following is highly preferred:

• Apollo

• ZoomInfo

• LinkedIn research

• Lead generation

• Contact research

• Data enrichment

List building

• B2B prospect research

• Federal government or agency research

• Large database projects

• Data verification

• Duplicate management



You do not need insurance experience to succeed in this role.

We are more interested in your ability to research, organize information, follow instructions,

maintain data quality, and consistently produce results.

What Success Looks Like



The right person for this position becomes someone our sales organization can depend on.

You consistently provide:

• Accurate prospect data

• Organized lists

• Reliable production

• Minimal unnecessary duplicates

• Clear documentation

• Strong daily communication

• Complete EOD reports

• Continuous progress from one workday to the next



When handed a research project, you should be able to understand the assignment, establish

an efficient research process, execute it, document your progress, and continue until the

project is complete.



HOW TO APPLY

We are specifically looking for candidates who pay attention to details.

Please include the word PRECISION at the beginning of your application.

Then answer the following questions:

1. How many years of lead generation, internet research, or data research experience do

you have?

2. Which of these tools have you personally used: Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, Google

Search, or other lead-generation databases?

Describe a project where you had to research and organize a large number of contacts

or companies. Approximately how many records were involved?

4. How do you prevent duplicate leads when working on a large research project?

5. If you were assigned 5,000 companies to research over several days, explain how you

would document your stopping point so another person could immediately continue

your work.

6. What steps would you take if the instructions for a lead-generation project were

unclear?

7. How do you balance speed with data accuracy?

8. What is your current internet speed and computer setup?

9. What hours are you available to work?

10. What is your expected monthly salary for a full-time position?



Practical Test



Candidates who advance may receive a short paid or unpaid skills assessment involving

prospect research, data organization, duplicate identification, and following written

instructions.



We are looking for someone who can become a long-term member of our operations team,

take ownership of their work, and help us continuously improve the way we generate and

manage prospect data.

Responsibilities

* Ability to follow design instructions and brand guidelines.

* Basic English communication skills.

The ideal candidate has a good eye for design and understands how product visuals can help customers quickly understand a product. You should be comfortable transforming basic product photos and information into polished, engaging, and easy-to-understand product listings.

title: looking for an experienced Senior IT Support Technician / Microsoft 365 Administrator based in the Philippines
description:
We are an Australian Managed Service Provider looking for an experienced Senior IT Support Technician / Microsoft 365 Administrator based in the Philippines.



This is not an entry-level help desk role.



We need someone who can confidently work across multiple client environments and who has real hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 tenant builds, Intune configuration, and tenant-to-tenant migrations.

 

These three areas are mandatory:

• Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations

• Building and configuring Microsoft 365 tenants from scratch

• Microsoft Intune configuration and deployment

If you have only basic Microsoft 365 administration experience and have not personally completed these tasks, this role is not suitable.



Core Responsibilities

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 remote support across multiple MSP clients

• Monitor and manage the support ticket queue

• Take ownership of issues from first response through to resolution

• Communicate directly with Australian clients

• Troubleshoot Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 and general business IT issues

• Escalate appropriately where required

• Maintain clear and accurate ticket notes and technical documentation



Microsoft 365 – Mandatory Experience

You must be able to:

• Build a new Microsoft 365 tenant from scratch

• Configure users, groups and licensing

• Configure Exchange Online

• Configure shared mailboxes, permissions and mail flow

• Configure SharePoint and OneDrive

• Configure Microsoft Entra ID

• Configure MFA

• Configure Conditional Access

• Configure security defaults and security policies

• Configure DNS and Microsoft 365 domain records

• Troubleshoot Microsoft 365 authentication, licensing and mail issues

Tenant-to-Tenant Migrations – Mandatory Experience



You must have personally completed Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations.

You should be comfortable with:

• Migration planning and discovery

• User and mailbox mapping

• Exchange Online mailbox migrations

• Shared mailbox migrations

• OneDrive migrations

• SharePoint migrations

• Domain cutover planning

• DNS changes

• User account preparation

• Licence planning

• Migration batching and cutover

• Post-migration testing

• Permissions validation

• Outlook profile remediation

• User communication and troubleshooting after cutover

We need someone who understands the whole migration process, not someone who has only assisted with one part of it.



Microsoft Intune – Mandatory Experience

You must be able to configure Intune from scratch, including:

• Intune tenant configuration

• Device enrolment

• Windows Autopilot

• Configuration profiles

• Compliance policies

• Endpoint security policies

• Application deployment

• Windows Update policies

• BitLocker policies

• Defender configuration

• Device restrictions

• Conditional Access integration

• Company Portal configuration

• Device retirement and wipe processes

• Troubleshooting failed deployments and enrolment issues

You should be comfortable taking a new client from no Intune configuration to a properly managed endpoint environment.



MSP Experience

Previous Managed Service Provider experience is strongly preferred.

You should understand:

• Working across multiple customers

• Ticket prioritisation

• SLAs

• PSA/ticketing systems

• RMM platforms

• Remote support tools

• Technical documentation

• Escalation processes

• Working independently

• Managing competing priorities

• Proactive ticket ownership



Responsiveness

This is extremely important.

During your working hours, you will be expected to:

• Actively monitor the support queue

• Respond to new tickets promptly

• Begin investigating issues quickly

• Keep clients updated

• Take ownership without needing to be chased

• Escalate urgent issues immediately

We are looking for someone who is present, responsive and proactive during working hours.



Additional Technical Skills

Experience in the following is highly regarded:

• Windows Server

• Active Directory

• Group Policy

• DNS and DHCP

• Hyper-V

• Networking

• VLANs

• VPNs

• Firewalls

• Switches

• Wireless access points

• Backup platforms

• Endpoint security

• Microsoft Defender

• Microsoft Entra ID security

• Microsoft 365 security



Security Stack

Experience with any of the following would be highly regarded:

• SentinelOne Complete

• SentinelOne Vigilance MDR

• Huntress ITDR

• Huntress Managed SIEM

• ThreatLocker

• Check Point Harmony

• Axcient Microsoft 365 Backup

• Microsoft Defender

• Microsoft Entra ID

• Conditional Access

You do not need experience with every product above, but you must have a strong understanding of modern endpoint, identity and Microsoft 365 security.



Communication

Excellent spoken and written English is essential.

You will be communicating directly with Australian clients, so you must be:

• Professional

• Clear

• Patient

• Confident on calls

• Able to explain technical issues in simple language

• Comfortable dealing with non-technical users

• Proactive with updates

• Calm under pressure



Minimum Requirements

• 3+ years professional IT support experience

• Previous MSP experience preferred

• Strong Microsoft 365 administration experience

• Proven tenant-to-tenant migration experience

• Proven Microsoft 365 tenant build experience

• Proven Microsoft Intune configuration experience

• Strong Windows troubleshooting skills

• Good networking knowledge

• Excellent written and spoken English

• Reliable internet connection

• Ability to work independently

• Strong documentation habits

• High level of responsiveness during working hours



To Apply

Please answer the following questions clearly:

1. How many years have you worked for an MSP?

2. How many Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations have you personally completed?

3. Describe the largest tenant migration you have completed.

4. Have you migrated Exchange Online, OneDrive and SharePoint between tenants?

5. Have you built a Microsoft 365 tenant from scratch?

6. What parts of the tenant did you personally configure?

7. Have you configured Intune from scratch?

8. Which Intune policies have you created?

9. Have you configured Windows Autopilot?

10. Have you deployed applications using Intune?

11. Have you configured Conditional Access and MFA?

12. Which PSA and RMM platforms have you used?

13. Which security platforms have you worked with?

14. Describe a difficult technical issue you personally diagnosed and resolved.

15. What is your current employment situation?

16. What hours are you available?

17. What is your expected monthly salary in PHP?



Please do not send a generic application.



We are specifically looking for someone who has personally performed Microsoft 365 migrations, tenant builds and Intune configuration and can clearly explain what they have done.



This role has strong potential to grow for the right person as the business expands.

Organizational Skills: Methodical approach to file naming, folder hierarchies, and digital asset management (DAM).

Confidentially is very important and work can't be shared publicly.



How to Apply

Please send a short video introducing yourself and sharing what you love about photography.

Secret Word: Include the word "BLUEPRINT" at the very top of your application so we know you read the complete job description.

title: Property Analyst with AI Skill
description:
We are looking for a Property Analyst with strong AI and data analytics skills to join our real estate team.



The role combines Singapore property market research, data analysis, AI tools and strategic insights. You will be responsible for turning large amounts of property data into clear, practical insights that can support property investment decisions, client presentations and marketing strategies.



The ideal candidate should have a strong interest in the Singapore property market and be comfortable using AI tools, data analytics and automation to improve the speed and quality of research.



Key Responsibilities

1. Property Market Research

Conduct research on the Singapore residential property market.

Analyse HDB, condominium, EC and landed property markets.

Track new launches, resale transactions, rental trends and price movements.

Research developers, projects, land sales and URA planning developments.

Monitor major market trends, government policies and property regulations.

Identify emerging growth areas and potential investment opportunities.



2. Property Data Analysis

Collect, clean and organise property data from various sources.

Analyse:

Transaction prices

PSF trends

Rental yields

Capital appreciation

Take-up rates

New launch performance

HDB resale prices

MRT accessibility

School proximity

District and planning trends

Build databases to compare properties and developments.

Identify patterns and relationships that may not be obvious from raw data.



3. AI & Automation

Use AI tools to speed up property research and analysis.

Develop AI-assisted workflows for:

Property research

Data collection

Market analysis

Report generation

Competitor analysis

Lead profiling

Content creation

Explore and implement AI tools that can improve the team's productivity.

Use AI to summarise large amounts of property information into actionable insights.

Assist in developing AI-powered property analysis tools and internal databases.

Automate repetitive research and reporting processes where possible.



4. Investment & Asset Progression Analysis

Analyse property scenarios for different buyer profiles.

Conduct comparisons between:

HDB vs private property

Resale vs new launch

Freehold vs leasehold

OCR vs RCR vs CCR

Different property sizes and locations

Support analysis on asset progression and retirement planning.

Develop financial and property models to assess potential upgrading strategies.

Identify potential risks and opportunities associated with different property strategies.



5. Market Reports & Presentation

Prepare easy-to-understand property market reports.

Convert complex data into simple charts, tables and visual presentations.

Prepare research materials for client presentations and seminars.

Provide data-backed insights for social media and educational content.

Support the team with facts, statistics and market evidence for property presentations.



6. Property Intelligence Database

Build and maintain a comprehensive Singapore property database.

Track historical and current information on:

Developments

Developers

Transactions

Launch prices

Land prices

Rental prices

MRT distances

Schools

Government land sales

Future developments

Continuously improve the database to support long-term market analysis.



Requirements

Essential

Diploma/Degree in Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, Computer Science or related fields.

Strong interest in the Singapore property market.

Strong analytical and research skills.

Good Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Ability to interpret property and financial data.

Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT and other AI platforms.

Strong attention to detail.

Good written and communication skills.

Preferred

Experience in Singapore real estate research or property analysis.

Knowledge of URA, HDB, SLA, MAS and Singapore property regulations.

Experience with data visualisation tools.

Experience with Python, SQL, Power BI or similar analytics tools.

Experience with web scraping or data automation.

Experience building databases.

Familiarity with AI automation and API integrations.

Experience analysing large datasets.

AI Skills Expected



The successful candidate should be able to use AI beyond simple prompting.



You should be able to:



Build effective AI research workflows.

Use AI to analyse property datasets.

Create structured prompts for property research.

Automate repetitive research tasks.

Use AI for data cleaning and categorisation.

Generate market reports using AI-assisted workflows.

Experiment with different AI platforms and identify useful applications.

Work with developers or AI engineers to improve internal AI systems.



Strong AI capability will be considered a major advantage.



Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)



Performance will be measured based on:



Accuracy and quality of property research.

Speed of completing market analysis.

Quality of property databases maintained.

Number of useful market insights generated.

Effectiveness of AI automation implemented.

Reduction in manual research time.

Quality of reports and presentations produced.

Ability to identify meaningful property trends.

Contribution to investment and asset-progression strategies.

Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who is:



Analytical + Curious + Tech-Savvy + Property-Focused



You should enjoy asking:



"What does the data tell us that other property agents are not seeing?"



The ideal candidate is not simply someone who collects property information. You should be able to connect the data, identify patterns and turn those findings into practical property strategies.

title: Documentary YouTube Producer / Video Editor – Potential Long-Term Opportunity
description:
I’m starting a faceless YouTube documentary channel called The Money Alibi focused on unbelievable true stories involving money, scams, fraud, corporate deception, rigged systems, and major financial schemes.



An example of the type of video we would produce:



“The Man Who Rigged McDonald’s Monopoly for Years”



Videos will generally be 10–15 minutes long and should feel like professional, entertaining mini-documentaries rather than generic “YouTube automation” videos.



What I’m Looking For



Ideally, I want someone who can take a topic or general video idea and handle most or all of the production process:



* Research the true story using reliable sources

* Fact-check important claims

* Write an engaging YouTube script

* Create or arrange voiceover/narration

* Source relevant footage, photographs, documents, headlines, etc.

* Create motion graphics/animations when appropriate

* Add music and sound design

* Edit the complete video

* Deliver an upload-ready finished video



Strong storytelling and viewer retention are very important. The first 30–60 seconds should hook the viewer, and the video should remain visually interesting throughout.



Copyright & Monetization



Everything used in the finished video must be appropriate for commercial YouTube use and monetization.



Footage, photographs, music, sound effects, graphics, and other assets must be properly licensed, public domain, original, or otherwise legally usable.



I want to avoid copyright claims, copyright strikes, and reused-content monetization problems.



Style



I’m looking for someone with experience in areas such as:



* Documentary filmmaking

* YouTube documentaries

* Visual storytelling

* Motion graphics

* Video editing

* Research-based content



I am not looking for low-quality AI-generated videos consisting of random stock footage over an AI voice.



I want these videos to feel like genuine mini-documentaries that someone would enjoy watching even if they had never heard of the story before.



First Project



The first project will be one paid test video approximately 10–15 minutes long.



If the quality and working relationship are good, this can become consistent long-term work producing additional videos for the channel.



When Applying



Please include:



1. 2–3 examples of your work that are closest to this documentary style.

2. Whether you can handle the entire process from topic ? research ? script ? narration ? visuals ? editing.

3. Which parts of the process, if any, you would need me to provide.

4. Approximately how many hours you would expect a 10–15 minute documentary to take.

5. Your hourly rate.

6. Where you normally source footage, photos, music, and other assets for monetized YouTube videos.



Please start your application with the words “Money Alibi” so I know you read the full posting.



I’m looking to build a long-term relationship with the right person rather than hire someone for only one video.

title: Growth & Marketing Lead | Paid Ads, Content Strategy, SEO & Funnels
description:
About Autonomous AI



Autonomous AI is a UK-based Business Technology Company.



We design, build, connect and continuously evolve intelligent Business Ecosystems combining AI, automation, CRM, marketing technology, websites, applications, customer operations and other business systems.



Our mission is:



“To build technology that continuously evolves so businesses don’t have to.”



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Growth & Marketing Lead who can take ownership of marketing and growth for Autonomous AI while also helping our clients grow.



This is not a role for someone who simply waits for marketing tasks.



We need someone who can:



Research ? Strategise ? Plan ? Execute ? Measure ? Improve



You will research markets and competitors, identify opportunities, develop marketing strategies and present major recommendations to the Founder for approval.



Once approved, you will be trusted to execute with a high level of independence.



We are a small team, so you must be comfortable working independently and getting things done yourself, while also knowing how to work effectively with creative, technical and other team members.



Your Core Responsibility



Your responsibility is not simply to generate traffic, followers or engagement.



Your responsibility is to help generate measurable business growth.



Autonomous AI works towards monthly sales targets. You will help translate those targets into an actionable growth plan:



Sales Target ? Customers Required ? Opportunities ? Qualified Leads ? Traffic ? Channels ? Campaigns & Content ? Conversion ? Revenue



You should monitor performance throughout the month and identify quickly when something is not working.



We want someone who asks:



“What do we need to change to achieve the target?”



—not someone who waits until the end of the month to report that a campaign failed.



Marketing Strategy & Direction



You will help shape how Autonomous AI goes to market.



Your strategy may influence:



Target audiences and customer segments

Customer acquisition

Website structure and messaging

Landing pages and conversion journeys

Digital content

Social media

Meta Ads

Google Ads

SEO, AEO and GEO

Marketing funnels

CRM and lead nurturing

Campaign planning

Creative direction

Marketing automation

Analytics and attribution



For major strategic changes, you will research the opportunity, explain your reasoning, define expected outcomes and present your recommendation to the Founder.



After approval, you will help drive implementation.



You Must Understand Digital Content



You do not need to be a professional video editor.



However, strong digital-content knowledge is essential.



You should understand what content is required to generate attention, traffic, trust, leads and conversions.



You should be capable of briefing our creative team on:



Target audience

Campaign objective

Content type

Message

Hook

Creative angle

Platform

Call to action

Customer journey

Expected outcome

Performance KPIs



You will work closely with our creative professionals to determine what content the business needs and why.



The creative team then handles specialist production and post-production.



Website & Conversion Strategy



Our website is a commercial growth asset, not simply an online brochure.



You should be capable of analysing:



Website positioning

User journeys

Landing pages

Conversion opportunities

Calls to action

SEO structure

Content requirements

Funnel integration

Lead capture

Customer journeys



If your research shows that our website or landing pages should change, you should be capable of developing the strategy and briefing the appropriate design/development resources.



You are not expected to be the website developer.

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Virtual Assistant – E-Commerce & Social Media+



Sparkles Crystal Candy



**Part-Time | Remote | Flexible Schedule**



Sparkles Crystal Candy is a growing specialty candy brand creating beautiful, handcrafted crystal candy inspired by the Japanese art of Kohakutou. We are looking for a **highly organized, creative, dependable Virtual Assistant** to help us manage the day-to-day online side of our growing business.



This is a great opportunity for someone who loves **e-commerce, social media, organization, and small-business growth** and wants to become an important part of a fun, creative brand.



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply wait for instructions. **We want a self-starter who can look at what needs to be done, prioritize tasks, and take initiative.**



What You'll Do



????? Shopify & E-Commerce



* Manage and update Shopify products, collections, pricing, descriptions, photos, and inventory

* Create and update product listings for new flavors and limited-edition collections

* Optimize product descriptions and listings for SEO

* Monitor orders and identify potential issues

* Help maintain accurate inventory and product information

* Assist with Shopify reports and basic sales tracking

* Help troubleshoot basic Shopify issues



???? Social Media



* Help manage Sparkles' Instagram and TikTok presence

* Create and schedule posts, Reels, Stories, and TikToks

* Write engaging captions that fit our fun, colorful brand voice

* Repurpose existing content into new social media content

* Monitor comments and messages

* Engage with customers and potential customers

* Track content performance and identify opportunities to improve

* Maintain a consistent content calendar



 ? Product Launches



Sparkles releases exciting new and limited-edition flavors, so launches are an important part of this position.



You will help:



* Prepare Shopify for new product launches

* Schedule launch-related social media content

* Create launch reminders and promotional content

* Double-check product listings, pricing, photos, and inventory

* Monitor launches and sales

* Help track launch performance

* Assist with planning upcoming collections



???? Customer Service



* Respond to customer
s, DMs, and basic product questions

* Assist customers with order and shipping questions

* Handle routine customer service issues professionally

* Escalate unusual or sensitive issues to the owner

* Follow up with customers when appropriate

* Help encourage product reviews and customer feedback



???? Wholesale & Business Growth



Help Sparkles expand into retail and wholesale accounts by:



* Researching potential boutiques, gift shops, candy stores, specialty retailers, and other potential stockists

* Building and maintaining a wholesale prospect list

* Finding appropriate buyer/contact information

* Sending approved outreach
s

* Following up with potential retailers

* Tracking leads and communications

* Researching local markets, events, and vendor opportunities



???? Influencers & Brand Ambassadors



* Research potential influencers and content creators

* Assist with influencer outreach

* Help manage our ambassador program

* Track discount/affiliate codes

* Organize user-generated content

* Maintain creator and ambassador records



???? Organization & Administrative Support



* Maintain spreadsheets and business records

* Organize Google Drive and digital files

* Help organize receipts, invoices, and business documents

* Maintain task lists and project timelines

* Create simple weekly reports

* Help develop and maintain SOPs

* Research suppliers, packaging, equipment, and other business needs

* Complete other administrative projects as needed



What We're Looking For



Must Have:



* Previous Virtual Assistant, E-Commerce, Administrative, or Small Business experience

* Shopify experience

* Social media experience, particularly Instagram and TikTok

* Excellent written English and communication skills

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to meet deadlines consistently

* Comfortable using Google Workspace and spreadsheets

* Reliable internet and computer

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Professional and friendly communication style



Bonus Points For:



* Experience working with a food, candy, beauty, fashion, or other consumer product brand

* Canva experience

* TikTok Shop experience

* Etsy experience

* Klaviyo or
 marketing experience

* Meta Business Suite experience

* SEO experience

* Influencer/affiliate marketing experience

* Wholesale/B2B outreach experience

* Experience creating SOPs

* Experience with product launches



 The Right Person for This Role



The ideal candidate is:



**? Proactive** – You notice what needs to be done without waiting to be asked.



**? Organized** – You can keep track of multiple projects, deadlines, launches, and follow-ups.



**? Creative** – You understand what makes social media content engaging and exciting.



**? Detail-oriented** – You catch mistakes before they become problems.



**? Resourceful** – If you don't know how to do something, you know how to research and figure it out.



**? Reliable** – When you say something will be done, it gets done.



**? Growth-minded** – You're excited about helping a small business grow rather than simply completing assigned tasks.



 Schedule



This is a **part-time remote position** with a flexible schedule.



Some availability during **U.S. Eastern Time business hours** is preferred, particularly around product launches and important business deadlines.

title: Shopify Fashion Product Lister – Long-Term Position
description:
We are looking for a reliable and experienced Shopify Product Lister to join our fashion e-commerce business on a long-term basis.



This role is not just about uploading products. We are looking for someone who understands how to turn a product into a professional, attractive and conversion-focused product page, while keeping the entire store visually consistent.



Your Responsibilities

Create and publish complete Shopify product pages from start to finish

Write or improve product titles, descriptions, benefits and product information

Create well-structured product collections and assign products correctly

Set up product variants such as colors and sizes

Add and check size charts using BF Size Chart or a similar Shopify app

Edit and prepare product images for the website

Remove supplier watermarks, unwanted text and distracting elements from images

Maintain a consistent and professional visual style across all products

Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Higgsfield or similar tools to create, improve or edit product images when necessary

Use AI efficiently for product copy, image concepts and other listing-related tasks

Optimize product titles, descriptions and image alt text for SEO

Check mobile and desktop presentation before publishing

Test images, variants, buttons, links and other product-page elements before a product goes live

Help organize and improve existing collections where needed

Who We Are Looking For



You should have:



At least 1–2 years of Shopify experience

Previous experience working with dropshipping or e-commerce stores

Strong experience with fashion products

A good understanding of what makes a fashion product page look trustworthy and convert well

Experience with Shopify variants, collections and product organization

Experience with BF Size Chart or another size-chart app

Good written English

Strong attention to detail

A good eye for branding, image quality and visual consistency

Experience using AI tools for e-commerce, especially for generating or editing product images

The ability to work independently without needing instructions for every small task

Availability around 5–6 days per week

Important



We are specifically looking for someone interested in a long-term collaboration. If the quality of your work is good, there will be consistent work and the possibility to take on more responsibilities over time.



Hourly rate: $4–$5 per hour

Start date: To be discussed

Work: Remote / ongoing



When Applying



Please send:



2–3 Shopify product pages or collections you have personally worked on

Examples of previous fashion e-commerce work

Examples of AI-generated or AI-edited product images, if available

Which AI tools you currently use

Your average time needed to complete one full product listing

How many days and hours per week you are available



Applications without previous Shopify work examples will not be considered.

title: Logistics Dispatcher - US Night Shift (Route Monitoring, Fast Paced)
description:
NIGHT SHIFT / US HOURS. READ THE SCHEDULE SECTION BEFORE APPLYING.



We are a US last-mile logistics company. We manage delivery routes for a major

national retailer across multiple US states. Our dispatch team sits between the

client and the delivery carriers, and we are the layer that catches problems

before they become late or failed deliveries. If a driver stalls, if a route

never gets created, if a package comes back - we are the ones who see it first

and get it moving.



We are hiring Dispatch Operators to monitor live routes during US business

hours.



-------------------------------------------------------------------

THE SCHEDULE - THIS IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS POST

-------------------------------------------------------------------



Shift: 8:30 AM - 5:30 PM US Central Time

In Philippine time that is 9:30 PM - 6:30 AM (next day).



This is a true graveyard shift. You will be working while the Philippines

sleeps. Some shifts may start EARLIER than 8:30 AM CT, never later.



- 5 days per week, 40 hours

- Schedules run Sunday-Thursday or Tuesday-Saturday (weekend work is required)

- Schedules are published at least 1 week in advance

- One 30-minute break plus two 10-15 minute breaks per shift

- You clock in and out through our time-tracking app



Do not apply if you are looking for a day shift, if you plan to "adjust later,"

or if you have another job or class during these hours. We have hired people

who thought they could handle nights and could not. It is a hard shift and we

pay for people who can actually do it.



-------------------------------------------------------------------

ATTENDANCE - PLEASE READ THIS TWICE

-------------------------------------------------------------------



Dispatch is a live position. When you are not at your desk, routes go unwatched

and deliveries fail. There is no one to cover you.



We have LIMITED TO NO TOLERANCE for attendance issues:

- A no-call / no-show is grounds for immediate termination

- Repeated tardiness, even by a few minutes, will end your employment

- Unplanned absences must be communicated with as much notice as possible

- Time off must be requested and approved in advance



We are not describing a policy we hope to enforce. This is the single most

common reason people do not make it past probation with us. If your internet,

power, or home situation cannot support reliable overnight work, this role will

not work for you.



-------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

-------------------------------------------------------------------



You will monitor a board of live delivery routes in our dispatch platform and

work them through every stage of the day:



- Track routes through their full lifecycle: route created, driver assigned,

  driver accepted, driver en route, driver arrived, loading, departed,

  delivering, completed

- Build and repost live status lists on a 5-minute cadence in our internal

  chat: pending route creation, pending driver arrival, pending dispense,

  pending departure

- Watch the clock against hard deadlines. Routes have fixed appointment

  windows. You will be escalating on set timers (for example: driver not

  assigned 10 minutes before dispense, driver not arrived 5 minutes after,

  loading not started 30 minutes after) - not when you get around to it

- Flag at-risk routes early: heavy stop counts, long mileage, drivers running

  behind pace

- Monitor driver activity for inactivity gaps and open stops, and raise them

  with the carrier's dispatch team

- Handle returns: log every returned package with the store, driver, stop

  number and reason

- Call delivery locations (apartment complexes, businesses) to get gate codes

  and access instructions so drivers are not stuck at a gate

- Write clean shift reports: mid-shift updates, end-of-shift summary, and a

  structured handoff to the incoming shift

- Keep accurate daily logs of cancellations and route issues in our tracker



You will be doing all of this at once, for dozens of routes, with numbers

changing minute to minute. On a normal day you are watching multiple waves of

routes across several stores while messages come in from carriers who need an

answer now.



-------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT WE REQUIRE

-------------------------------------------------------------------



- Proven experience working the US night shift. Tell us how long, and where

- Experience in a FAST PACED, DATA HEAVY role - dispatch, logistics, transport,

  fleet, freight, BPO operations, live monitoring, command center, order

  management, or similar. You must be comfortable holding many moving numbers

  at once and working from live dashboards and spreadsheets

- Fast response time. When a carrier or a teammate messages you, you answer in

  minutes, not when you next check. Speed of communication is the whole job -

  the delivery window does not move

- Strong written and spoken English. You will be writing in group chats that

  our client and our carrier partners read

- Solid attention to detail. A missed store number or a wrong stop count sends

  a driver to the wrong place

- Comfortable with spreadsheets (Google Sheets / Excel) and quick to learn new

  web platforms

- Reliable computer, a stable primary internet connection, a backup internet

  option, and a quiet place to work overnight

- Able to work independently overnight without someone standing over you, and

  willing to ask questions when you are unsure



-------------------------------------------------------------------

NICE TO HAVE

-------------------------------------------------------------------



- Prior last-mile, courier, trucking, freight or 3PL dispatch experience

- Experience communicating with US-based teams or clients

- Experience with route tracking or TMS platforms

- Experience calling US phone numbers



-------------------------------------------------------------------

WHAT WE OFFER

-------------------------------------------------------------------



- $383.20 USD per bi-weekly pay period (40 hours per week). This is a salaried

  position paid every two weeks - not an hourly wage - but you are still

  required to clock in and out for your shift and breaks for attendance

  tracking

- Paid by bank transfer

- Paid time off

- Internet / equipment stipend

- Full paid training - we have a complete training program, written SOPs, and

  live shadowing with experienced dispatchers before you are given your own

  routes

- A real growth path: Dispatch Operator I -> Dispatch Operator II (Lead) ->

  Operations Manager. Our current leads were hired as dispatchers. We promote

  from inside first

- A team that is growing fast. We are adding carriers and states, and we want

  people who will grow with it



-------------------------------------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

-------------------------------------------------------------------



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. In your application, put "NIGHT OWL" as the

first word of your message, then answer these four questions:



1. How many months or years have you worked a US night shift, and at which

   company?

2. Describe the fastest paced, most data heavy role you have held. How much

   volume were you handling at once (calls, orders, routes, tickets, accounts)?

3. What is your internet speed, and what is your backup plan if your internet

   or power goes out mid-shift?

4. Confirm in your own words that you understand this shift is 9:30 PM to

   6:30 AM Philippine time, 5 days a week, including weekend days. Confirm 

   also that you understand the support needs / timing / dates may change

   based on business needs.



Applications that do not start with "NIGHT OWL" and answer all four questions

will not be reviewed. This is the first test of whether you read carefully and

follow instructions - which is exactly what the job is.

title: Advanced SEO and Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Elite-level Internet Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist with proven experience handling difficult and high-profile online reputation cases. We work with high-profile individuals, including celebrities, executives, public figures, and brands, and we need someone who understands how to handle reputation issues that can spread rapidly across the internet.



This is not a traditional SEO or social media position.

We are looking for someone experienced in advanced content removal, search suppression, de-indexing, takedown coordination, and reputation recovery.



To give you a better understanding of the type of cases we handle:

Imagine a high-profile celebrity such as Beyoncé has an embarrassing incident during a live performance. Someone records the incident, uploads the video, and within hours the footage is being reposted across Google, social media, news websites, and other platforms. We are looking for a specialist who understands how to approach a situation like this and legitimately pursue removal of the original and replicated content wherever possible, while also addressing the resulting search visibility. This is the level of complexity and urgency we are looking for—not simply removing a negative review or improving a Google ranking.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute advanced ORM strategies

- Identify the source and spread of damaging content

- Pursue legitimate content removal and takedown opportunities

- Evaluate available Google and platform removal processes

- Develop search-suppression strategies when removal is not possible

- Coordinate with publishers, platforms, and legal counsel when appropriate

- Develop authoritative content to strengthen positive search results

- Monitor Google rankings, indexing, and search visibility

- Provide regular reports and recommendations



Experience with several of the following is strongly preferred:

- Advanced Online Reputation Management

- Viral or high-profile content removal

- Search-result suppression

- Google de-indexing and removal processes

- Website and platform takedowns

- Legal/policy-based removal requests

- Technical SEO

- High-authority content publishing

- Reputation management for celebrities, executives, or public figures

- Complex cases involving news websites, social platforms, government websites, court records, or other authoritative sources



We are not looking for someone who only has basic SEO, backlink building, keyword research, or Google review management experience. We need someone who has actually handled complex ORM cases and can demonstrate real results.



TO APPLY, PLEASE
 
 and provide:

- Your ORM experience

- Examples of difficult cases you have handled

- Results you achieved

- Your experience with content removal, de-indexing, or search suppression

- Case studies, screenshots, or other proof of results where possible



If you have experience handling high-profile, viral, or difficult online reputation problems, we want to hear from you.

Successful candidates may have the opportunity to work with us on a long-term basis, with potential for a full-time position.

Readability is extremely important.

eBooks

Workbooks

Guides

Magazines

Reports

Instead:

description:
Community Growth & Lead Generation Specialist



Remote | Philippines | Part-Time | Long-Term Opportunity



The Hygienist Bar is changing the conversation around oral health.



We believe the mouth shouldn't be treated as something separate from the rest of the body. We focus on the environment teeth and gums live in—including gum health, saliva, bacteria, the oral microbiome, inflammation, and prevention.



We're looking for someone who can do much more than generate a list of names.



We need a curious researcher, communicator, and relationship builder who can learn our philosophy, understand why oral health matters, find people already asking questions about it, and join those conversations intelligently.



This is NOT a high-volume cold-calling position.



What You'll Do



Research gum health, saliva, the oral microbiome, preventive oral health, and the relationship between oral and overall health.



Find people online who are already asking questions about bleeding gums, gum disease, bad breath, oral bacteria, dental anxiety, oral microbiome, and preventive health.



Research their questions before responding.



Provide helpful, educational answers based on credible sources—never diagnose or give medical advice.



Identify conversations where The Hygienist Bar could genuinely help.



Build relationships with potential guests rather than immediately trying to sell them.



Identify local wellness businesses and potential referral partners.



Research functional medicine, longevity, fitness, wellness, and health professionals who align with our philosophy.



Find relevant influencers, creators, podcasts, organizations, and community partners.



Follow up with existing THB leads and inquiries.



Help interested people move naturally from education ? conversation ? appointment.



Track every lead, conversation, follow-up, and appointment in our CRM/Google Sheets.



The Person We're Looking For



You are naturally curious.



When someone asks:



“Why do my gums bleed?”



You don't immediately try to sell them something.



You research the question.



You understand what credible sources say.



You learn enough to have an intelligent conversation.



And you know when the appropriate answer is to recommend seeing a licensed healthcare professional.



That's the mindset we're looking for.



Excellent spoken and written English is essential.



Experience in dental, medical, wellness, fitness, healthcare marketing, research, community management, or appointment setting is a major advantage.



APPLICATION TEST — IMPORTANT



Please do not send us a generic application.



Before applying, spend some time researching gum health and oral-systemic health.



Then answer this question in your own words:



Why does gum health matter beyond simply keeping your teeth?



Imagine someone on 
 or
 asked you that question.



Write the response you would give them.



Please tell us:



1. Why gum health matters



2. What you've learned about the relationship between oral health and overall health



3. Two credible sources you used to research your answer



4. How you would answer the person without sounding like you're selling them something



Then send us a 60–90 second video introducing yourself and explaining one thing you discovered during your research that surprised you.



We are not looking for the person who already knows everything about oral health.



We're looking for the person who knows how to learn, research, communicate, and become genuinely passionate about what we're building.



Compensation



$4–$6 USD/hour to start + performance bonuses



Approximately 20–25 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a much larger role.



The Hygienist Bar



We don't just clean teeth. We pay attention to the environment they live in.

- Collaborate efficiently: Manage your workflow using Asana, Google Sheets, and shared QA checklists.

- Advanced Parametric Experience: Proven ability to build highly flexible families (portfolio and .RFA samples are required).

- Professional Organization: Ability to structure and name parameters cleanly and logically.

- Work Ethic: Strong attention to detail, proactive problem-solving, and comfortable with English documentation.

**** Why Join Us? ****

100% Remote: Work from home with flexible hours.

Skill Growth: Get consistent feedback from industry experts to elevate your BIM skills.

Career Progression: Long-term collaboration with the potential to grow into a Senior Modeler or QA Leadership role.

This full-time freelance position is targeted toward candidates based in Southeast Asia (Philippines, Thailand, Myanmar, etc.), as our budget is benchmarked to competitive full-time freelance rates in these regions.





***** How to Apply *****

Send an
 to 

Subject: Revit Family Modeler — [Your Name]

1. A short introduction about your experience with complex parametric modeling.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer For Payment Systems - Next.js, WP, Shopify

You should be highly experienced in modern JavaScript frameworks, cloud-based deployment workflows, and production-ready engineering practices. We are especially looking for someone with strong Next.js, Docker, and CI/CD pipeline experience, and a proven track record of shipping real applications that users actively use.



What You’ll Do

Build and maintain modern web applications using Next.js, React, and related technologies

Architect scalable frontend and backend systems

Set up, improve, and manage CI/CD pipelines

Containerize applications and services using Docker

Deploy and manage applications across staging and production environments

Collaborate with product, design, and other developers to deliver polished features

Write clean, testable, maintainable code

Review code, improve engineering standards, and help guide technical decisions

Troubleshoot production issues and optimize performance, reliability, and security

Take ownership of projects from concept to launch

Required Skills

Strong senior-level experience as a full-stack or web developer

Expert-level experience with Next.js and React

Strong knowledge of JavaScript and/or TypeScript

Experience building and launching production-ready web applications

Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines

Strong experience with Docker and containerized workflows

What We’re Looking For

This role is best suited for a developer who has actually built and shipped live applications, not just worked on internal codebases.

title: Technical SEO & AEO Specialist (SaaS & B2B) - Project to Monthly

- Conduct deep technical SEO audits (crawl errors, indexability, site speed, JavaScript rendering, and site architecture).



- Implement and manage advanced Structured Data / Schema Markup (JSON-LD) to maximize visibility in AI search engines and rich snippets (AEO / GEO).



- Optimize Core Web Vitals, page speed, and crawl budget efficiency.



- Design and execute Programmatic SEO infrastructures to build scalable, high-converting technical landing pages.



- Monitor and report technical health, indexation, and AI search visibility using tools like Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, and Semrush.



Requirements:



- Proven hands-on experience in Technical SEO, Site Audits, and AEO/GEO for B2B SaaS or Tech companies.



- Proficiency in technical diagnostic tools (Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, PageSpeed Insights, Ahrefs, Semrush).



- Deep understanding of Schema Markup, canonicalization, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, and indexing mechanisms.



- Familiarity with how Large Language Models (LLMs) crawl and source data for AI-generated answers.



- Highly structured, data-driven, and systematic approach to problem-solving.



MANDATORY APPLICATION REQUIREMENT:

To be considered for this role, you MUST include a link to a 1-minute video or audio recording answering these two questions:



1. Briefly introduce yourself and your hands-on experience in Technical SEO audits and fixing complex crawling/indexing issues.

Send your resume along with the link to your 1-minute audio/video recording (via Loom, Google Drive, Vocaroo, etc.).
