title: eBay Virtual Assistant
description:
eBay Listing & Product Research Virtual Assistant - Part-Time, Long-Term



I am looking for a reliable virtual assistant to help research products and create eBay listing drafts for my resale business.



This is ongoing, long-term work. I currently have approximately 35 new products per week that need to be listed, and I expect this to increase to approximately 50–60 products per week. This job is approximately 3–6 hours of work per week right now, depending on your listing speed.



For each product, I will generally provide:



* ISBN, UPC, SKU, or product name

* Quantity

* Any important notes I already know about the item



Many of the products are new books, special/exclusive edition books, collectibles, and other new retail merchandise.



For each item, you will:



* Find appropriate product images from online sources

* Research current eBay listings and sold/completed listings

* Determine an appropriate suggested selling price

* Create an accurate, optimized eBay title

* Select the correct eBay category

* Complete relevant item specifics

* Write/prepare the listing description

* Select the appropriate existing shipping/business policies

* Create the draft listing directly in my eBay account using eBay Team Access

* Flag anything you are uncertain about rather than guessing



A large portion of my inventory consists of books, including retailer-exclusive, signed, special, or limited editions.



You must carefully verify that you are researching the exact edition I provide. A standard edition and a Barnes & Noble Exclusive Edition, for example, should not be treated as the same product.



ISBNs, UPCs, retailer information, cover designs, edition features, and other identifying information should be checked carefully.



If you cannot confidently verify something, I would much rather have you ask or flag the item than make an assumption.



I'm looking for someone who:



* Has strong written English and reading comprehension

* Is comfortable researching unfamiliar products online

* Understands how to research eBay sold/completed listings

* Has strong attention to detail

* Can distinguish between different editions/variations of similar products

* Is comfortable working independently

* Communicates clearly when information is missing or uncertain

* Is comfortable using a text-based chat platform for day-to-day communication, questions, and updates, like Slack or Teams

* Can maintain reliable weekly availability for ongoing work



Experience with books, collectibles, retail arbitrage, or similar products is a plus.



Current volume: approximately 35 listings per week



Expected near-future volume: approximately 50–60 listings per week



The workload may continue to grow over time.



This is intended to be a long-term part-time position for the right person, not a one-time project.



There will be a small paid test assignment before ongoing work begins.



In your application, please include your preferred hourly rate and approximately how many researched eBay listings you can typically complete per hour.

title: Drafts Person/interior Design
description:
## Remote Interior Design Draftsperson – Australian Healthcare Fit-Outs



Doctors&Co Fitouts is an Australian company specialising in the design coordination and delivery of medical and healthcare fit-out projects.



We are seeking an experienced remote draftsperson with interior-design capability to support our growing design and project-delivery team on an ongoing basis.



### Responsibilities



* Prepare tenancy and fit-out drawings using landlord-provided CAD and base-build documentation.

* Develop healthcare layouts from client briefs, sketches and marked-up plans.

* Produce general arrangements, demolition plans, reflected ceiling plans, flooring plans, internal elevations and joinery details.

* Assist with interior space planning, finishes, materials and presentation drawings.

* Coordinate architectural drawings with hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, fire and structural documentation.

* Update drawings following consultant, certifier, landlord and client feedback.

* Ensure documentation considers the current Australian National Construction Code, relevant Australian Standards and applicable state or territory requirements.

* Maintain accurate drawing registers, revisions, title blocks and file-management standards.



### Requirements



* Strong AutoCAD skills.

* Revit, SketchUp, Enscape or Lumion skills are advantageous.

* At least three years’ experience in architectural or commercial interior drafting.

* Experience with healthcare, medical, dental, allied-health or commercial fit-out projects is highly desirable.

* Understanding of Australian construction documentation and accessibility requirements, including AS 1428.1, is strongly preferred.

* Ability to interpret landlord drawings, surveys, consultant plans and construction mark-ups.

* Strong attention to detail and good written and spoken English.

* Ability to meet agreed deadlines and maintain regular communication with our Australian team.

* Reliable computer, internet connection and access to the required drafting software.



This is a remote position with the potential for regular, long-term work. Some availability during Australian business hours will be required for coordination meetings.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid drafting test.



### How to Apply



Please submit:



* Your résumé.

* A portfolio showing complete technical or construction drawing packages.

* Examples of healthcare or commercial interior-design work.

* Details of your AutoCAD, Revit and 3D-modelling experience.

* Your expected hourly or monthly rate in USD.

* Your availability and preferred working hours.



Please note that portfolios containing only 3D renders will not be sufficient. We require examples demonstrating technical drafting, construction documentation and interior-design capability.

title: METALWORK ESTIMATOR

This is a permanent work-from-home position fully aligned with Australian Eastern Standard Time (AEST). You will work directly with our Australian management team to deliver precise, competitive material takeoffs and quotes.

title: Part-Time Virtual Assistant — Ownership-Driven & Self-Directed
description:
About the Role



I'm looking for a sharp, self-directed virtual assistant to help me with my personal projects and activities — including supporting an AI-focused community I help run, organizing content, and handling various tasks. This is flexible, project-based work where you'll take ownership of assignments and run with them.



Here's the most important thing to know: I'm not looking for someone who already knows every tool. I'll teach you the AI systems, workflows, and processes you need. What I can't teach — and what I'm actually looking for — is mindset.



Who You Are (This Matters Most)



Ownership: You treat the work as your own. When something needs doing, you take it across the finish line without being chased.

Independent thinking: You solve problems on your own before escalating. You figure things out rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.

Initiative: You anticipate what's needed and act on it, instead of waiting to be told.

Reliability & follow-through: When you say you'll do something, it gets done — completely, and on time.

What You'll Help With



Project-based tasks I assign (research, content support, community coordination, administrative work, and more)

Learning and using AI tools and systems (I'll train you — no prior AI expertise required)

Helping keep my projects organized and on track

Bringing ideas and initiative, not just execution

How This Works



This is project-based, not fixed weekly hours. Here's the flow:



We align on a defined chunk of work (roughly a $100 increment of tasks).

I'll spend time scoping what needs to be done and allocate it to you.

You complete the work, I review and validate it, and we close it out.

Then we scope the next increment — and we grow from there, continuously, as more work comes up.

This means the work flows in defined, completable chunks rather than open-ended hours — so you always know exactly what "done" looks like.



Availability



Regular sync: I'd like you available for a check-in Mondays and Fridays at 2:30–3:00 PM PST (US Pacific) to align on work and review progress. (Early on, these check-ins will also help you get up to speed; they'll stay flexible as you settle in.)

Occasional urgent sync: On rare occasions, if something urgent comes up, I may need you available on a Saturday morning PST for a quick sync. This will be uncommon, but I need someone who can be reachable when it genuinely matters.

Requirements



Reliable internet and a quiet work environment

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

Comfortable learning new technology (AI experience is a plus, but not required — mindset matters more)

Good working English (you can use AI tools to help polish written communication)

Able to make the Monday and Friday PST check-ins, and occasionally available for a rare urgent Saturday-morning PST sync

Nice to Have (But Not Required)



Familiarity with AI tools (Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT)

Experience with community support, content, or online organization

Compensation



Please share your hourly rate in your application. Work will be structured in $100 increments — we'll agree on a defined scope of work for each increment, you complete it, I validate it, and we move to the next. This keeps everything clear and fair for both of us.



How to Apply



I don't want a résumé full of tool names. I want to see how you think. So here's a scenario — tell me how you'd handle it:



You're helping me with an online community I run. One morning, you notice an
 from a member saying they're frustrated: they registered for a live session, but the calendar invite had the wrong time, and now they think they missed it — and they're upset. You also realize a few other members might have gotten the same wrong-time invite. I'm offline for the next 3 hours and can't be reached.



Tell me: What do you do, and why? Walk me through your thinking.



There's no single "right" answer — I want to see how you approach a problem, take ownership, and think it through on your own. Please write a few short paragraphs. In your application, also include your hourly rate. I'm far more interested in your thinking than in a polished résumé.



(Applications that skip the scenario won't be considered.)

title: Supplier Coordinator
description:
About us



Here Now Adventures is a curated adventure travel platform. We connect travellers with small, independent guides and operators running genuinely interesting trips - fly fishing in South Africa, gravel riding in Spain, river expeditions in Madagascar, mountain biking in Tuscany.



We are deliberately not a mass-market travel booking site. We work with a small number of operators we've vetted properly, and we care more about who we work with than how many.



We're early. The platform is built and live, and we're now growing the supply side. This is the job.



The role



You own the supplier journey from first contact to launch-ready.



That means finding operators worth approaching, making the first approach, and then running the whole onboarding process - gathering what we need from them, chasing what's missing, and handing over a complete, ready-to-build listing.



You are the person who makes sure nothing stalls.



What you'll actually do



Pipeline research



- Find small and mid-sized adventure operators who fit what we do

- Build and maintain a prospect list with enough detail for us to judge quickly: what they run, where, group sizes, why they're interesting

- Learn what a good fit looks like and get sharper at it over time



Outreach



- Send first-contact
s to prospective suppliers, using our templates and tone

- Handle the back-and-forth up to the point of a serious conversation

- Recognise when someone isn't a fit and move on without wasting time



Onboarding



- Run new suppliers through our onboarding process, step by step

- Occasional supplier video calls

- Collect what we need: insurance certificates, cancellation and refund terms, group size limits, rate sheets, availability

- Gather adventure content for the website platform listing - descriptions, day-by-day itineraries, what's included and what isn't, difficulty guidance, kit lists, meeting points, and high-resolution photos

- Help suppliers fill in their own details on the platform when they get stuck

- Chase politely and persistently. One nudge, then a decision — we don't chase indefinitely

- Keep supplier folders and records organised so nothing goes missing



Flagging and escalation



- Tell us when a supplier is ready for review

- Tell us when something's off: vague answers, missing insurance, terms that don't work, a supplier who's gone cold



What you won't do

- You won't publish suppliers or adventures. Final sign-off and publishing stay with us.

- You won't set pricing or negotiate commercial terms.

- You won't handle customer bookings, customer support, or payments.



What we need from you



Excellent written and spoken English. Most of your work is written — you'll be
ing operators in South Africa, Spain, Italy, USA and elsewhere, and your
s need to read like a person wrote them, warm and direct, not corporate. You'll also join occasional video calls with suppliers, so you need to be comfortable holding a conversation.



Judgment. You'll be making calls on when to follow up, when to push, when to let something go. We can't answer every question in real time.



Genuine independence. We're often tied up for hours at a stretch and can't respond quickly. You need to keep things moving on your own and batch up your questions rather than waiting on us.



Attention to detail. Missing insurance documents and half-finished content are the difference between a trip going live and a trip sitting in limbo.



Organisation. You'll be tracking a dozen suppliers at different stages simultaneously.



Useful but not essential: experience in travel, tourism, hospitality, or logistics. An interest in the outdoors.



How it works

- Contractor arrangement, invoiced monthly, paid via Wise or other mainstream platform such as PayPal

- Two to three weeks of paid training upfront so you learn our process, our standards, and how we talk to suppliers

- Weekly check-in call; otherwise asynchronous

- Working hours must overlap with European and African mornings (roughly 2pm–7pm Philippine time)



If this works well, there's scope to grow the role - more hours, more responsibility, and eventually help on the marketing and content side



To apply



Send us:



- A short note - a few paragraphs, not a formal cover letter - telling us about a time you had to chase someone for something and actually got it. What did you do?

- Your CV or a link to your profile.

- Your available hours and your monthly rate for 20–25 hrs/week.



And do this: go to our website, pick one adventure listed there, and tell us in a few sentences what kind of operator you think we'd want to work with next, and why. You don't need to be right. We want to see how you think.



Applications without that last part won't be read.

title: Video Editor for News Reels & Advertiser Videos
description:
Mirror Media Group is looking for a fast, reliable video editor to create short-form vertical videos for our local news brands. This is an ongoing remote freelance role, ideal for someone who is comfortable working on quick-turnaround news content and polished advertiser videos.

We operate multiple local media publications in California and produce news coverage, community stories, social clips, and advertiser content. We need an editor who can turn supplied footage and creative direction into engaging 30–60 second reels efficiently.

What You’ll Edit

You will create vertical videos for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and similar platforms, including:

• Breaking-news and daily news-program clips

• Short videos promoting local news stories

• Reporter or host-led reels

• Community and event coverage

• Advertiser and sponsored-content reels

• Simple promotional videos for our publications and clients

We will generally provide some combination of:

• Raw video footage

• A selection of preferred shots or timestamps

• Written copy, article text, headlines, or captions

• Voiceover audio or on-camera dialogue

• Logos, brand assets, photos, and/or music direction

• Basic notes on the intended story angle and format

Your role is to take those elements and produce a clean, engaging, platform-ready short video.

Responsibilities

• Edit 30–60 second vertical videos, primarily in 9:16 format.

• Create compelling openings/hooks within the first few seconds.

• Select the strongest footage and pace edits for social-media viewing.

• Add captions, headlines, lower thirds, branding, music, graphics, and relevant visual elements.

• Ensure videos are clear, accurate, professional, and appropriate for a local news organization.

• Export files optimized for social platforms.

• Make reasonable revisions when needed.

• Communicate clearly and meet short deadlines, including occasional same-day or next-day turnaround.

Requirements

• Strong experience editing short-form social video, especially Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts.

• Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software.

• Excellent English comprehension for editing news scripts, captions, headlines, and voiceovers.

• Ability to create accurate burned-in captions/subtitles.

• Strong sense of pacing, storytelling, audio, and visual hierarchy.

• Reliable internet connection and availability to communicate during agreed working hours.

• Ability to work quickly without sacrificing polish or accuracy.

• Experience with news, journalism, local media, real estate, restaurants, events, or advertiser content is a plus.

• Familiarity with Canva, motion graphics, simple animations, and social-media trends is a plus.

Important: Turnaround Time

This is a news-based role, so turnaround speed matters. Some projects may need to be completed the same day or within 24 hours after assets and instructions are delivered.

Please apply only if you can consistently communicate status, ask questions promptly, and deliver on deadline. We value reliability and responsiveness as much as editing skill.

Compensation Structure

We want to begin with a paid trial arrangement and build toward a long-term relationship with the right editor.

Please include your preferred pricing for both of the following options:

• A per-video rate for 30–60 second reels, with a guaranteed minimum number of videos during the first 30 days.

• A monthly bulk-package rate for a defined number of videos per month.

For example, tell us your rate for 10, 20, or 30 edited reels per month, including what is covered in that rate and how many rounds of revisions you include.

If the first month goes well, this can become a steady monthly role with a predictable video volume and monthly stipend/retainer.

To Apply

Please send:

1. A brief introduction and your relevant editing experience.

2. Links to 3–5 examples of vertical short-form videos you edited yourself.

3. Your software/tools and typical turnaround time for a 30–60 second reel.

4. Your per-video rate and monthly package options.

5. Your availability, time zone, and weekly capacity.

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with same-day or next-day turnaround for urgent news-related assignments.

7. The word “NEWSREELS” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full posting.

We are looking for someone dependable, fast, creative, and interested in a long-term working relationship with a growing local media company.

title: Remote Bookkeeper
description:
About the Role

Dynamic Decisions is a U.S.-based bookkeeping and fractional CFO firm that helps small business owners maintain clean books, improve financial reporting, and better understand their numbers.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Remote Bookkeeper / Accounting Assistant based in the Philippines to support bookkeeping, reconciliations, client follow-up, and month-end close across multiple client accounts.

This is a remote independent contractor role. Prior experience working in a bookkeeping firm, accounting firm, CPA firm, outsourced accounting provider, or other multi-client bookkeeping environment is required.

We are specifically looking for someone who is already comfortable managing multiple client files, following different procedures for different clients, and working through recurring monthly close processes.



What You'll Do

• Categorize transactions in QuickBooks Online and/or Xero

• Prepare bank and credit card reconciliations

• Match receipts, invoices, and supporting documents

• Review bank feeds and identify transactions that need clarification

• Prepare organized client question lists

• Support month-end close checklists

• Clean up uncategorized or incorrectly categorized transactions

• Track missing documents and open items by client

• Prepare basic financial reports for review

• Identify unusual transactions, duplicate entries, reconciliation issues, or possible errors

• Organize accounting documents and workpapers

• Follow written SOPs and document recurring client processes

• Help keep multiple client files organized and moving toward completion

You will initially prepare work for review rather than being responsible for finalizing financial statements or making significant accounting changes without approval.

You will also not initially be responsible for filing tax returns, filing sales tax returns, processing payroll, moving money, paying bills, or communicating directly with clients without approval.



Required Experience

• Previous experience working for a bookkeeping firm, accounting firm, CPA firm, outsourced accounting provider, or multi-client bookkeeping team

• Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple clients at the same time

• Experience using QuickBooks Online for U.S.-based clients

• Experience preparing bank and credit card reconciliations

• Experience working from monthly close checklists and client-specific procedures

• Strong understanding of bookkeeping fundamentals, including AR/AP, loan payments, merchant deposits, payroll entries, and balance sheet accounts

• Strong written and spoken English

• High attention to detail

• Ability to manage recurring deadlines without constant reminders

• Ability to recognize when something does not look right and ask thoughtful questions

• Reliable internet access and comfort working securely with confidential financial information



Preferred Experience

• Xero

• U.S. small business bookkeeping

• Monthly close packages

• Reviewing P&Ls and balance sheets for unusual items

• Service businesses, professional services, fitness businesses, real estate, or project-based businesses

• Keeper, Hubdoc, Dext, Bill.com, Ramp, Gusto, Stripe, Square, Shopify, or similar platforms

• Documenting client-specific bookkeeping procedures



What We're Looking For

We are not looking for someone who simply "codes transactions." We want someone who thinks like a bookkeeper - someone who notices inconsistencies, double-checks their work, asks questions when something is unclear, and keeps organized notes.

• Switching between multiple clients without losing accuracy

• Following different rules and procedures for different clients

• Tracking open questions and missing information

• Preparing clean work for review

• Meeting recurring monthly deadlines

• Communicating when something is blocking their work

• Receiving feedback and improving over time

• Taking ownership of assigned responsibilities



Work Schedule

This is a remote independent contractor position.

We are seeking someone with full-time availability and capacity, approximately 40 hours per week.

Some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time is needed for communication and collaboration. Our preferred overlap window is approximately 5:00 PM-7:00 PM Pacific Time, which is morning in the Philippines.

Outside of scheduled meetings and agreed-upon overlap periods, the contractor will generally have flexibility in determining when and how assigned work is completed, provided deadlines, quality standards, and client requirements are met.



Compensation

$7-$14 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated bookkeeping skill.

The higher end of the range is intended for candidates with strong U.S. bookkeeping experience, substantial multi-client experience, and the ability to work independently with limited supervision.

Please include your desired hourly rate in your application.



How to Apply

Please send:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your resume or summary of bookkeeping experience

3. Your desired hourly rate

4. Your availability and preferred work schedule

5. A screenshot or description of your internet speed

6. A Loom video answering all of the screening questions below

Loom video requirement: Please keep your video to approximately 5-10 minutes. You do not need to create a polished presentation. We simply want to hear you explain your experience and how you approach bookkeeping situations in your own words.

Required subject line: Detail-Oriented Multi-Client Bookkeeper

Applications that do not include both the required subject line and Loom video may not be reviewed.



Loom Video Screening Questions

1. Tell me about your experience working for a bookkeeping firm, accounting firm, CPA firm, outsourced accounting company, or other multi-client bookkeeping environment.

2. How many client files were you typically responsible for at one time, and what types of businesses did you support?

3. Walk me through the bookkeeping tasks you personally handled during a typical monthly close.

4. How did you track client questions, missing documents, outstanding reconciliations, and other open items across multiple clients?

5. Tell me about the most difficult bookkeeping cleanup, reconciliation issue, or accounting problem you have worked on. What was wrong, and how did you help resolve it?

6. Imagine you are supporting 8 different client files in QuickBooks Online. Each client has different coding rules, month-end deadlines, and open questions. How would you organize your work to make sure nothing is missed?

7. You see a $247.83 bank transaction paid to "Amazon," but there is no receipt or description. Walk me through exactly what you would do before categorizing the transaction.

Qualified candidates may be asked to complete a short bookkeeping skills test and participate in a video interview.

title: Stand-Up Comedy Content Editor & Social Media Growth
description:
My name is Ian Stanley I’m a professional stand-up comedian looking for someone to help me turn my stand-up, podcasts, and other long-form content into short-form videos for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube.



But there’s one requirement that matters more to me than anything else:



**You need to genuinely love stand-up comedy.**



I don’t mean you’ve watched a few Netflix specials.



I’m looking for someone who consumes American/English stand-up comedy in their free time. You should have favorite comedians. You should watch comedy clips online. You should understand why one joke is funny and another isn't.



Stand-up is incredibly nuanced, so you also need an excellent grasp of English. You need to understand sarcasm, timing, wordplay, cultural references, double meanings, and the little details that make comedy work.



If you don't genuinely love stand-up comedy, please don't apply.



What You'll Be Doing



Your primary job will be taking my existing content and finding the best moments to turn into short-form social media clips.



You'll work with:



* Stand-up comedy footage

* Podcasts

* Longer videos

* Other comedy content



You'll turn that footage into entertaining short-form videos designed for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



You'll also be responsible for posting and testing content across these platforms.



On Instagram specifically, I want to aggressively use Trial Reels to test content. Our goal will be to post **at least 10 Trial Reels per day**, learn what works, and then do more of it.



This is not a job where I want to hand you five timestamps every morning and tell you exactly what to edit.



Initially, I'll give you plenty of direction.



But eventually, I want you to know my comedy well enough that you can watch an hour of footage and think:



"That's the clip."



I Want Someone Obsessed With Growth



I'm not interested in posting content just so we can say we posted content.



**I want views. I want followers.**



I want someone who gets excited when a video takes off.



I want you looking at the analytics and asking:



Why did this one get 800,000 views?



Why did this one get 8,000?



Was it the hook?



The joke?



The edit?



The caption?



The length?



The first two seconds?



What happens if we package the same joke differently?



I want us constantly testing, learning, and improving.



Your goal isn't simply to edit videos.



**Your goal is to help grow my audience.**



And I want to financially reward you for doing that.



In addition to your normal pay, I'll create a bonus structure based on the number of views our content generates each month.



If we win, you should win too.



## Who I'm Looking For



You might be a great fit if:



* You genuinely love American stand-up comedy

* You regularly watch comedians and comedy clips in your free time

* Your English comprehension is excellent

* You understand sarcasm, irony, timing, wordplay, and American cultural references

* You have experience editing short-form vertical video

* You understand Instagram Reels, Trial Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

* You understand hooks, pacing, captions, retention, and short-form storytelling

* You're comfortable posting a high volume of content

* You're interested in analytics and figuring out WHY content performs

* You're proactive and don't need every decision made for you

* You want to get ridiculously good at growing social media accounts



Hours



We'll initially start at approximately **4 hours per day / 20 hours per week**.



Think of the first 30 days as a paid trial for both of us.



If you're great at this and we're getting results, I'm very open to turning this into a full-time position.



I'm looking for someone who could potentially work with me for years, not someone looking for a random short-term editing project.



How To Apply



Please answer these questions:



1. Who are your 5 favorite stand-up comedians?



2. What's your favorite stand-up special you've watched in the last year?



3. Send me links to 3 short-form videos you've personally edited.



4. If I gave you a 60-minute stand-up set, how would you decide which moments should become clips?



5. Tell me about a short-form video you've edited that performed well. How many views did it get, and why do you think it worked?



6. What editing software do you use?



7. What's your current availability?



**IMPORTANT:** Start your application by telling me the funniest stand-up comedian you've ever seen live or online and why you like them.



If you don't answer that question, I won't read the rest of the application.

title: Short-Form Video Editor — High Volume, Long-Term
description:
We're a social media management company. We manage Instagram and TikTok content for a growing roster of lifestyle/influencer creators. We need editors who can take raw footage and turn it into a large amount of distinct, publishable reels — consistently, every week, long term.



THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS ROLE — READ THIS FIRST



The core skill we are hiring for is reskinning. We will send you one piece of raw footage. We need you to produce 2-3 separate reels from it that Instagram does not detect as the same video.



This is not about making one video look pretty. It's about producing many variants that are materially different to the platform's detection systems while staying visually consistent for the audience. If you already do this, you know exactly what we mean and you should apply. If you've never heard of it, this role isn't for you.



Concretely, per variant you'd be changing things like:

- A different audio track on every single variant (Instagram matches the audio fingerprint, not just the video — same sound on two uploads means both get flagged as non-original)

- Different on-screen text and a different hook in the first second

- Different caption

- Slightly different crop, zoom or framing

- Slightly different colour grade

- Different in/out points — different trim, different clip order, different length



We don't want identical re-uploads with a new caption slapped on. We want variants that pass as original content. You should be able to explain to us, in your application, how you approach this.



THE REST OF THE WORK



Beyond reskinning, most edits are genuinely simple. You get raw vertical footage plus a reference reel showing the exact style we want. In many cases the job is: trim, captions, audio, export. We're hiring speed, consistency and volume.



WHAT WE NEED

- Proven Instagram Reels / TikTok editing experience — send links to actual posted videos, not a showreel

- Demonstrable experience with content repurposing and reskinning

- Capacity for 100+ finished reels per month minimum, sustained, without quality dropping

- You work from a written brief and match a reference — you don't reinvent the style

- 24-48 hour turnaround on batches

- You understand short-form: hook in the first second, captions inside the safe zone, 9:16, trending audio



PAY

Fixed rate per finished reel, paid per batch. Tell us your rate in your application. This is ongoing work with a monthly minimum, not a one-off project, and the volume grows as we grow. If you're fast and reliable, this is stable income every single month.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Links to 3 short-form videos you personally edited

2. In two or three sentences: how do you reskin one video into multiple uploads without it getting flagged as non-original?

3. Max finished reels per week you can genuinely deliver

4. Your software, your timezone, your rate per reel

title: Social Media/Digital Content/Graphics
description:
# Social Media & Digital Content Specialist



**Part-Time | 15–20 Hours Per Week | Long-Term Opportunity**



I run a busy political consulting firm in California, working with candidates and campaigns on strategy, communications, digital content, fundraising and voter outreach.



I'm looking for a smart, creative and highly reliable person to become an important part of our team. This is **not simply a social media posting job** and it is not a traditional administrative VA position. I'm looking for someone who can handle a wide range of digital, creative and research projects — and who takes real pride in producing excellent work.



### What You'll Do



**Social Media & Content**



* Create professional, engaging graphics for
, Instagram and other platforms

* Create and edit Reels and short-form video

* Create Stories, endorsement graphics, event graphics, issue posts, quote cards and other campaign content

* Format and schedule approved social media posts

* Maintain content calendars for multiple clients

* Resize and adapt content for different platforms

* Help organize photo, video and creative assets



**Graphic Design & Digital Materials**



* Design invitations, event graphics, flyers,
 graphics and other digital materials

* Work within established campaign branding and templates

* Create new concepts when needed without making everything look like a template

* Make revisions quickly and accurately



**Websites & SEO**



* Make routine updates to campaign websites

* Add endorsements, events, photos, news and other content

* Format pages so they look polished and professional

* Handle basic SEO, including page titles, descriptions, keywords, links and image optimization

* Identify opportunities to improve search visibility



**Research & List Building**



* Conduct online research on organizations, endorsers, media, community groups, elected officials and other campaign targets

* Find and verify names, titles,
 addresses, phone numbers and other contact information

* Build clean, accurate spreadsheets and outreach lists

* Research topics and provide concise, useful findings — not pages of copied search results



### Who I'm Looking For



You should be:



* An **excellent Canva user** with a strong design eye

* Very strong Adobe Express user

* Comfortable editing short-form video

* Experienced with social media platforms and scheduling tools

* Comfortable working with websites such as Squarespace

* Familiar with basic SEO

* A very good online researcher

* Excellent with Google Sheets/Excel and list building

* Able to understand written English extremely well

* Detail-oriented and obsessive about accuracy

* Fast, responsive and dependable

* Comfortable juggling several projects and clients

* Able to follow established branding and instructions

* Willing to ask questions when something isn't clear

* Capable of working independently once you understand an assignment



You do **not** need previous U.S. political campaign experience. I can teach you the political side. I cannot teach attention to detail, good judgment, creativity or a strong work ethic.



### Very Important



This is a fast-moving business. Sometimes we'll know what's coming several days in advance. Sometimes a major endorsement comes in and we need a great graphic that day.



I don't expect you to be available 24/7, but **responsiveness and communication matter a lot**.



I also care about quality. I would rather have someone tell me, "I can have this done in two hours" and deliver something excellent than send me mediocre work in 20 minutes.



### Schedule



Approximately **15–20 hours per week to start**, with the potential for additional hours and responsibility for the right person.



Because we're based in California, some overlap with U.S. Pacific Time will be important. We can work out a schedule that provides both regular working hours and reasonable flexibility.



### Compensation



**$10–$15 USD/hour to start, depending on experience and portfolio.**



I'm willing to pay well for someone who is genuinely excellent. This is intended to be an ongoing position, not a short-term project.



### How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself and why this position interests you.

2. Links or samples showing your **best social media graphics, digital design and short-form video work**.

3. Examples of websites you've worked on, if applicable.

4. A brief description of your experience with SEO, online research and list building.

5. The programs/platforms you use regularly.

6. Your hourly rate and typical availability.



Please **do not send a generic application** telling me you are hardworking, passionate and perfect for the position. Show me what you can do.



I'm looking for someone who wants to become a trusted part of a small, busy team and do work they can be proud of. If you're creative, resourceful, fast and extremely good at what you do, I'd like to hear from you.

title: Real estate operations coordinator | bookkeeping | marketing | executive support
description:
## About Us



Triple Heart Homes is a growing residential real estate investment company based in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.



We buy, renovate, sell, and hold residential properties. We are building a long-term business with strong systems, clear responsibilities, and a dependable team.



We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented **Real Estate Operations Coordinator** who wants a stable, long-term full-time position and the opportunity to grow with our company.



Your primary job is simple: **help keep the business organized, make sure important tasks and follow-ups do not get missed, and free up the owners to focus on deals, relationships, and growing the company.**



## Your Main Responsibilities



### 1. Bookkeeping & Financial Organization



* Receive and organize receipts, invoices, bills, and other financial documents.

* Maintain an organized Google Drive filing system.

* Keep financial documents organized separately by property and project.

* Match receipts and invoices to transactions.

* Upload receipts and supporting documents into QuickBooks Online.

* Categorize routine transactions according to our established bookkeeping procedures.

* Assist with bank and credit-card reconciliations.

* Track missing receipts and documents and follow up with us when something is missing.

* Keep QuickBooks organized and current for review by our Canadian bookkeeper/accountant.

* Help prepare property and renovation expense summaries.



### 2. Operations & Executive Support



* Help manage calendars, appointments, deadlines, and reminders.

* Review calendars and priorities each day and identify anything requiring attention.

* Maintain company task lists and follow up on overdue items.

* Keep Google Drive, company documents, property files, and systems organized.

* Update trackers, spreadsheets, property records, and internal systems.

* Turn recurring tasks into checklists and simple written procedures.

* Provide a short daily update showing what was completed, what is outstanding, and what requires our attention.



### 3. Lead & Team Follow-Up



* Review our lead-management system and help ensure leads are being followed up with on time.

* Identify overdue or missed follow-ups.

* Remind our lead qualifier/acquisitions team of required follow-ups and outstanding tasks.

* Help maintain accurate lead records and notes.

* Flag important leads or tasks that require the owners' attention.



You will **not** be responsible for closing real estate deals. Your responsibility is helping make sure opportunities and follow-ups do not fall through the cracks.



### 4. Marketing & Social Media Support



We will provide the ideas, raw videos, photos, and much of the original content. Your responsibility will be to help turn that material into consistent, professional marketing.



Tasks may include:



* Edit and improve basic videos, photos, and graphics.

* Create professional-looking social media content using tools such as Canva.

* Write or improve captions based on material we provide.

* Organize our content library.

* Schedule and publish approved content consistently.

* Repurpose content across
, Instagram, and other platforms.

* Maintain a content calendar so we remain consistent.

* Track what has been posted and what content is coming next.



We are **not looking for someone to create our entire marketing strategy from scratch.** We want someone who can take the content and direction we provide and reliably turn it into polished, consistent output.



## What We're Looking For



You should be:



* Extremely organized and detail-oriented.

* Proactive — you notice things that are being missed and bring them to our attention.

* Dependable and consistent.

* Comfortable reminding team members and owners about outstanding tasks.

* Able to work independently after being trained.

* Comfortable asking questions instead of guessing.

* Excellent at written English communication.

* Trustworthy with confidential business and financial information.

* Interested in a stable, long-term role where your responsibilities can grow over time.



## Required Skills



* Experience as a Virtual Assistant, Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, or similar role.

* Practical experience with QuickBooks Online.

* Experience organizing receipts, invoices, expenses, and digital files.

* Strong Google Drive, Google Sheets, Gmail, and Google Calendar skills.

* Experience with Canva and basic social-media content creation.

* Strong task management and follow-up skills.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.



## Preferred Experience



These are advantages but are not required:



* Real estate investing, construction, renovation, or property-management experience.

* Canadian bookkeeping or GST knowledge.

* Property-level bookkeeping or job costing.

*
 and Instagram business-page management.

* Video editing.

* CRM experience.

* ClickUp, Asana, Trello, or similar project-management software.



## What Success Looks Like



Within 60–90 days:



* Receipts and financial documents are organized and processed every week.

* QuickBooks records are current and organized for professional review.

* Every property has organized supporting financial records.

* Our calendars, deadlines, and important tasks are under control.

* Lead follow-ups are being monitored and overdue follow-ups are identified.

* Social-media content is being prepared and posted consistently.

* The owners are spending significantly less time on administration.

* Recurring processes are being documented so the business becomes more organized as we grow.



## How to Apply



Please begin your application with the words **“Three Hearts”** so we know you read the entire job posting.



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself and why this position interests you.

2. Your experience with QuickBooks Online and the specific tasks you have personally performed.

3. Your experience organizing receipts, invoices, financial documents, and digital files.

4. Your experience managing calendars, tasks, and follow-ups for busy business owners.

5. Your experience with Canva, social media, and basic content/video editing.

6. Any experience you have in real estate, construction, renovation, or property management.

7. The software and tools you are most comfortable using.

8. Your desired monthly salary or hourly rate in USD.

9. Whether you currently work for other clients and, if so, approximately how many hours per week.

10. A 2–3 minute video introducing yourself and explaining how you would help keep a busy real estate company organized.



**Scenario Question:**



Imagine you start work Monday morning and discover:



* 25 new receipts need to be organized.

* Several transactions in QuickBooks are missing receipts.

* The owners have multiple appointments this week.

* Five sales leads have overdue follow-ups.

* Three raw videos are waiting to be edited and scheduled for social media.



Explain **step-by-step how you would prioritize and organize your day.**



Selected candidates will complete a short **paid skills test** and video interview.



We are looking for someone who values **accuracy, organization, communication, initiative, honesty, and long-term growth** — not simply the fastest applicant.



We want someone who can eventually become an important part of our team and help us build a more organized and scalable company.

title: Business Development Associate
description:
Business Development Associate (Part-Time, Remote – Work from Home)



The Opportunity

Are you someone who loves the mission of turning a cold introduction into a real client engagement? 

Do you thrive on building structure around a fast-moving pipeline, so that no opportunity is ever left to go cold?



We're looking for a highly capable Business Development Associate to remotely support an expanding Australian based growth advisory firm working across business development, account management, new product development, and strategy.

This is not a typical task taker VA role. This is an opportunity to step into a genuine business development position for the long-term, starting part-time (20 hours per week), with the opportunity to grow in scope and responsibility (up to 40 hours per week) as the advisory firm continues to grow.



About the Role

This role sits at the centre of the business's growth engine. Approximately 60% of your time will be spent supporting business development and sales activity with a key commercial partner (the Partner Organisation) – researching opportunities, building prospect lists, managing outreach and keeping the pipeline moving.



The remaining 40% will support the advisory firm’s own LinkedIn presence, business development and existing client relationships, including content, engagement and outreach.



You will work closely with the Business Owner, who remains the primary salesperson and relationship lead, and play a critical role in providing the research, systems and follow-up that allow deals to progress and client relationships to be protected.



Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Prospecting (Primary Focus)

? Research agencies, prospective clients, partners and commercial opportunities for the Partner Organisation.

? Build and maintain targeted prospect lists based on agreed criteria.

? Identify relevant decision-makers and gather useful commercial information before engagement.

? Conduct structured outbound outreach and consistent follow-up.

? Support the booking of meetings and sales conversations for the Business Owner.

? Research active opportunities to add useful context ahead of sales conversations.



CRM & Pipeline Management

? Maintain the CRM as the central source of truth for all business development opportunities.

? Record and track every prospect, contact and opportunity accurately.

? Update pipeline stages and manage follow-up activities and next actions.

? Maintain accurate forecasting information.

? Provide clear visibility of pipeline activity and upcoming priorities.



LinkedIn & Content Support

? Support the Business Owner's personal LinkedIn presence (approximately 3 posts per week).

? Draft content that reflects the Business Owner's natural voice and professional positioning.

? Manage LinkedIn content for approximately 3-4 existing clients (9-12 posts per week combined).

? Support engagement, connections and direct message outreach.

? Maintain an organised and forward-planned content calendar.



Client & Relationship Management

? Maintain professional and timely communication with prospects, clients and business partners.

? Follow up outstanding actions and commitments proactively.

? Support existing client relationships.

? Identify potential issues or relationship risks and raise them early.



Reporting & Process Improvement

? Provide regular progress updates on pipeline, outreach and LinkedIn activity.

? Help build repeatable systems for prospecting, CRM management and follow-up.

? Identify inefficiencies and suggest practical improvements.



About You

You are not only organised, you are commercially minded and treat every opportunity like it's your own business. You take genuine ownership, communicate clearly, and follow through without needing to be chased. You build real relationships rather than approaching people transactionally, people trust you.



You are comfortable working in an environment where priorities can shift and systems are still being built. You are not a typical "task taker," you think ahead, take initiative, and understand that your work is directly connected to revenue. You genuinely value growth, hard work, integrity and helping the businesses you support to scale. 



You MUST have your own safe, private and distraction-free home office with a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet and stable power.



Experience & Skills

? Experience in business development, sales, lead generation, account management or a related commercial role.

? Experience using CRM or sales pipeline management platforms.

? Strong research skills and able to qualify prospects, not just build contact lists.

? Experience managing LinkedIn profiles or business content.

? Strong written English with the ability to draft professional, personalised outreach and content.

? Understanding of the sales lifecycle from initial prospecting through to conversion.



Personal Attributes

? Proactive and takes initiative 

? Highly accountable and reliable 

? Friendly, approachable and comfortable in an informal but professional environment 

? Strong attention to detail, especially across CRM and follow-up 

? Commercially minded and focused on outcomes, not just activity 

? Ambitious and motivated to grow with the business 



What's on Offer

? Part-time role: Starting at 20 hours per week (4 hours per day, Monday–Friday). 

? $10 AUD per hour (non-negotiable as a start). 

? Performance and results bonuses and incentives.

? Remote position – work from home. 

? Opportunity to build a business development function from the ground up. 

? Work directly with the Business Owner and contribute to real, measurable revenue growth. 

? Potential for the role to grow in scope and responsibility as the businesses grow. 



How to Apply

Please submit:

? Your RESUME and a SHORT VIDEO with your own 1-2 minute elevator pitch based on the role and why you should get the role.

? A short summary outlining your experience with business development, sales, CRM systems, LinkedIn prospecting/outreach and content creation and management. 

? Briefly explain how you typically qualify a prospect and what sets you apart from other candidates. Please ensure your summary is written by you and tailored to this role. Do NOT provide an AI generated response (I can tell). 



Important note: 

*Please ONLY apply if you are looking for a long-term position and are comfortable with a role that blends business development, account management, CRM management and content support. A lack of punctuality, integrity, professionalism or follow-through will not be tolerated. 

*Please ONLY apply if you feel this role is genuinely in your natural environment and strongly aligns with your CV, if this role feels like too much of a "stretch" for you and doesn't align with your skillset or experience, please do not apply. 

*Lastly, please ONLY apply if you are able to eventually commit 40 hours per week as and when the role may require it.

Josi Health is a fast-growing, virtual-first healthcare company dedicated to making  neurodivergent care (including evaluations & therapy) faster, more accessible, and stress-free for families. We operate across 40+ states, navigating a complex landscape of commercial insurance carriers and state Medicaid programs. Because our clinical model is virtual-first, having bulletproof front-end patient access and benefit structures is critical to preventing administrative delays and billing denials.



About the Role

We are seeking a highly analytical, detail-obsessed Eligibility, Benefits, & Prior Authorization Specialist who loves the investigative side of healthcare administration. In this role, you will not just perform data entry. You will act as an internal researcher and gatekeeper, digging into payor portals, insurance policy and benefits updates, and clinical guidelines to uncover the exact steps needed to secure prior authorizations and verify complex telehealth benefits.



This role is a blend of high-velocity queue management and deep-dive policy research. You will review incoming clinical orders, cross-reference them with payer requirements, clear daily scheduling queues, and build process playbooks where none exist. If you thrive on solving insurance puzzles, de-escalating complex scheduling bottlenecks, and keeping clinical schedules perfectly authorized, you will excel here.



Key Responsibilities



1. Insurance Verification & Telehealth Benefit Research

- Verify active patient insurance coverage, deductibles, co-pays, co-insurance, and coordination of benefits (COB) across commercial plans

- Conduct in-depth research on payer-specific policies regarding virtual care, remote developmental pediatrics, and psychological evaluations (CPT 90791, 96130, etc.)

- Navigate payor websites, newsletters, and provider manuals to track and document shifting policy guidelines and billing modifiers across 40+ states



2. Order Verification & Prior Authorization Management

- Review incoming clinical diagnostic referrals and orders to ensure demographic, insurance, CPT, and ICD-10 data are flawless

- Initiate, track, and validate prior authorizations through clearinghouses (e.g., Availity, Waystar), insurance portals, and phone escalations

- Ensure all authorizations are secured, confirmed accurate, and fully documented in the EMR before the close of business each day for upcoming clinics



3. Ambiguity Resolution & Playbook Creation

- Act as the go-to resource for clinical teams when a payer's prior-authorization process is vague, contradictory, or unmapped

- Validate conflicting information from multiple insurance sources to determine the most credible, risk-free path for claim submission

- Build, update, and maintain internal state-by-state reference guides on commercial insurance and state-by-state regulatory requirements



4. Clinic Coordination & Stakeholder Communication

- Prepare clear, professional patient insurance benefit letters outlining estimated out-of-pocket costs and referral requirements

- Collaborate closely with clinic coordinators and clinical staff to resolve last-minute scheduling exceptions or authorization gaps

- Help de-escalate patient or provider concerns regarding coverage limits with professional, empathetic communication



What We're Looking For



Must-Have

- 2+ years of healthcare clinic or startup experience specializing in insurance verification and prior authorizations

- Strong research capabilities: deep comfort navigating payor portals, digging through policy manuals, and calling payor representatives to clarify ambiguous rules

- Hands-on experience working with multiple major commercial payers (e.g., BCBS, Optum, Aetna)

- Working knowledge of medical terminology, CPT, ICD-10, and telehealth billing modifiers

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills: ability to translate technical insurance terms into simple, clear explanations

- High-speed internet, backup power setup, and the ability to work full-time during EST business hours



Preferred (Not Required)

- Medicaid familiarity is a plus

- Experience in virtual care, digital health, or behavioral/mental health environments

- Experience utilizing modern EHRs (e.g., Athenahealth) or CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce)

- Experience building internal SOPs or process documentation from scratch



What We Offer

- 100% remote work from anywhere outside the US

- The opportunity to join a fast-growing, mission-driven team with clear professional growth

- Full access to modern operational tools and tech

The Role

This is a phone-first sales role, plain and simple. Your success is measured on one thing above all: leads converted into confirmed bookings. Everything else supports that.

- Generate new leads through outbound outreach to construction firms, engineering companies, and other businesses needing crew accommodation — especially when inbound leads are running low, so the pipeline never dries up

- Nurture new and existing leads through to a booking — persistent, warm follow-up, not one-off contact

- Own the phone — confident, aggressive, persuasive calls that close deals. This is what we’re hiring for, and it’s the single biggest priority for this hire

- Proactively review the booking calendar to spot voids or underperforming periods at specific properties, and work leads/past guests to fill them

- Keep lead-tracking spreadsheets updated (contacts, pitch angles, follow-up status)

- Earn uncapped commission on every lead you personally convert into a booking — the better you close, the more you earn.



Also required: PMS Familiarity



- Be comfortable working within our property management system (PMS) to check availability, pricing, and booking details as part of the sales process



Also core: Reviews & Reputation



- Make a friendly mid-stay check-in call to every guest — building rapport so a 5-star review ask feels natural, not transactional

- Call guests toward the end of their stay to nudge stay extensions where relevant

- Monitor guest reviews across all platforms (Airbnb, Google, direct site, etc.)

- Proactively work to secure 5-star reviews and build up scores on any underperforming properties — identify recurring complaints and feed them back to us

- Respond to reviews professionally and promptly, and flag negative feedback early before it affects our rating



*Note: mid-stay and extension calls sit with this role; day-to-day guest queries and pre-check-in remain with our existing team.*



Also core: CRM (GoHighLevel)**



- Manage and nurture leads within our GHL CRM (2,000+ contacts) day-to-day — the system and campaigns are built separately, so your focus is working the leads they generate, not building the system or campaigns

- Move leads through the pipeline via calls and follow-up, using the CRM to track status

- Keep pipelines, tags, and contact data clean



Bolt-on duties (secondary, smaller share of your time):



- Turno (Cleaning/Turnover Software): Help set up and manage scheduling for cleaner turnovers

- General Admin: Light data entry, scheduling, and research support (training provided — PriceLabs, Hostfully)



*Guest communications and pre-check-in remain with our existing team — this role is focused on new business.*



Requirements



Essential:



- Proven sales/closing experience — this is a proper sales role, not general admin with some calling. We need confident, persuasive, aggressive phone sales that actually convert

- Lead generation experience — finding and qualifying new prospects, not just working a given list

- Previous VA experience specifically in short-term rentals (STR) — you need to understand this industry and why direct bookings matter, not just be able to make calls

- Excellent spoken and written English with a strong, professional telephone manner

- Hands-on GoHighLevel experience — comfortable managing leads and pipelines within an existing system

- Experience with review/reputation management (Airbnb, Google, etc.)

- Comfortable working within a PMS, including reading occupancy/calendar data to spot booking gaps

- Willing to work exclusively with F&S Properties



Preferred:



- Experience with Turno or similar turnover software

- Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets



Trial Period



Before the ongoing role begins, shortlisted candidates complete a short paid trial:



- Duration: 5–7 days, roughly 5–8 hours of work

- Pay: Flat trial fee, paid regardless of outcome

- Task: Contact a small batch of real contractor leads by phone, log outcomes in a simple tracker, and report back on contacts made, responses, and any bookings/interest generated



Why Work With Us



- A growing business with a clear, real strategy — you’ll build systems that matter, not busywork

- Direct communication, clear expectations, straight feedback

- Long-term role for the right person as we scale



To Apply



Send your CV plus brief answers to:



1. Describe a sales or booking role where you closed deals over the phone — your approach, and real results/numbers if you have them

2. Describe your STR (short-term rental) VA experience, including any PMS you’ve used

3. How would you describe your telephone manner, and why do you think it’s a strength?

4. If inbound leads were running low, how would you go about finding new leads yourself?



*Applications without all three answered will not be considered.*

title: Virtual Assistant - Product Mockups, Social Media & E-commerce Support
description:
Company: Custom Card Tools (
)

Location: Remote

Hours: Starting at 10-15 hours/week, with a clear path to near full-time

Schedule: Minimum 2 hours per day, with availability during US afternoon hours (2-4 PM ET preferred)

Compensation: $4-6/hour USD depending on experience

Start: Immediately



ABOUT THE HOURS

This role starts part-time, but the workload is variable. Some days may only need a couple of hours. Others, especially when order volume is high or a project deadline hits, may require significantly more. We are looking for someone who is flexible, available when the work is there, and interested in growing this into a near full-time position as responsibilities expand. Hours are negotiable and will increase as you learn the business and take on more.



ABOUT US

Custom Card Tools manufactures premium stainless steel multi-tool cards and metal business cards with custom laser-etched and printed branding. Our products are used by construction companies, real estate firms, service businesses, and trade show exhibitors as high-end promotional items and client gifts. We are a growing e-commerce business processing 30-45 orders per month at a high average order value, and we need a reliable, detail-oriented virtual assistant to help us keep up with demand.



This is not a one-task role. You will be involved in multiple areas of the business from day one, and the right person will grow into a key operational role over time.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES (DAY ONE)



Product Mockup Creation (Primary Task)

You will create customer mockups using Adobe Illustrator. We process 20-30 mockup requests per week. You will receive forwarded customer
s containing logos, branding details, and product specifications. You will work from pre-built templates for our main product lines, placing the customer's artwork and details into the correct layout, then reply directly with the completed mockup. This is a repeatable, template-based process. You do not need to be a designer. You need to be fast, accurate, and consistent in Illustrator.



Social Media Management

You will manage our Instagram and TikTok accounts. This includes selecting from existing product photography, writing captions and hashtags, and posting consistently (every 1-2 days minimum). You may schedule posts in advance or manage them in real time. The goal is a steady, professional presence showcasing our products.



 Management

Initially, work will be forwarded to you. Over time, you will manage your own inbox, receiving and responding to mockup requests and customer inquiries directly.



Shopify Store Updates

You will log into our Shopify admin to add tracking numbers to orders once our supplier provides them. This is straightforward data entry.



File Organization

You will organize and maintain our Dropbox file library, including product photography, customer card photos, logo files, and design assets. This is a significant cleanup project that needs dedicated attention.



GROWTH RESPONSIBILITIES (WITHIN 3-6 MONTHS)

As you learn the business and build product knowledge, we plan to expand your role into:

- Mockup follow-up: Reaching out to customers who received a free mockup but have not yet placed an order. Templated but personalized communication.

- Quote and invoice preparation: Creating Shopify draft orders and invoices for bulk inquiries using standard pricing templates. Approximately half of our sales are completed through manually created invoices, so this directly supports revenue.

- Reorder outreach: Contacting past customers on a schedule to encourage repeat orders, especially around trade show season and year-end gifting periods.

- Supplier coordination: Communicating with our manufacturing supplier via a group chat (WeChat) to relay order details, ask questions, and get updates.

- Marketing
 support: Assisting with Mailchimp
 campaigns, including list management, scheduling sends, and basic reporting.

- Customer service: Responding directly to customer questions about products, pricing, turnaround times, and order status.



REQUIREMENTS

- Proficient in Adobe Illustrator. You must be comfortable working with templates, placing logos and text, and exporting production-ready files.

- Near-perfect written English. You will be communicating directly with US-based business customers. Grammar, spelling, tone, and professionalism are non-negotiable.

- Basic proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Comfortable learning and using AI tools to improve efficiency and output quality.

- Reliable internet connection and a computer capable of running Adobe Illustrator.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Self-motivated. You will be given tasks and trusted to complete them without constant supervision.



PREFERRED BUT NOT REQUIRED

- Familiarity with Shopify admin.

- Experience with social media management (Instagram, TikTok).

- Familiarity with WeChat.

- Experience with Mailchimp or similar
 marketing platforms.

- Previous experience in e-commerce, promotional products, or B2B businesses.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send your application with the following:

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your relevant experience.

2. Examples of work you have done in Adobe Illustrator (mockups, layouts, or template-based design work preferred).

3. A note about your availability and typical working hours.



Qualified applicants will be asked to complete a short paid test task: creating a product mockup from one of our templates using provided customer details. This will take approximately 30 minutes and will be compensated.



This is a long-term role. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with the business, not someone looking for a short project. If you are reliable, detail-oriented, and eager to take on more responsibility over time, we want to hear from you.

Another started in customer support and now runs the entire customer support team. We promote from within and invest in people who want to grow.

???? Full Flexibility – Work from anywhere, anytime. We run on trust and results, not time tracking—as long as the work gets done, your hours are yours.

???? Learning Budget – Courses, books, consulting calls—we cover it. Many team members book calls with founders of big ecommerce brands or managers at major companies through platforms like intro.co and mentorpass.co.

?? Two Company Retreats a Year, Fully Paid – We rent a house in a new country each time, explore, and actually get to know each other. Here is a video of our last company retreat: 

? Loved by the Team – Rated 5 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor (
)



???????? The Skinnify Story

Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. They didn't have the time, the motivation, or the consistency to make the gym work.

The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively — while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk? Fitness without the extra time or effort.

The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked — so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.



????? Our Products

What started with a single product — leggings with built-in resistance bands — has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more. We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.



???? Skinnify's Core Values

???? Innovation – We design new, groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.

???? Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories & get fitter with every step.

???? Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone — even the busiest and least motivated.

???? Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.

? Quality – Our products are built to last — high-quality, durable, and reliable.



Ready to design creatives that inspire millions and drive real business growth? Apply now and let's build the future of fitness together.
