title: Social Media Strategist/Manager - Personal Brand
description:
Reports to: Creative Lead

Works alongside: Video editor (already in place)



Account focus - A brand for women rebuilding themselves after a major life transition.



It started from my own breakup, leaving a long-term relationship and having to rebuild from nothing. That's where the audience found me, and heartbreak is still the door people walk through. But the brand isn't about the breakup. It's about what comes after: becoming emotionally and financially independent, building a career and a business, and creating a life you're genuinely excited about.



VOLUME (per month)



20 Reels — I film, my video editor cuts, you brief and review

4 Carousels — you write and design

2 Photo posts — I supply photos, you edit and caption

15 Stories — you



Reels are filmed by me across 2–4 batch days. Open to adjusting these numbers up or down once we see what's working.



CONTENT CALENDAR & STRATEGY



Plan and own the monthly content calendar across TikTok and Instagram

Research top-performing creators in the niche and adjacent spaces; identify what's already working on my accounts

Post to find outliers , anything doing 5x normal reach, then double down deliberately: same angles, same topics, new variations

Build content that attracts buyers, not random views. No trends for the sake of trends



SCRIPTING & FILMING DIRECTION



Script a full month of short-form content in advance

Give me clear filming direction: what to shoot, angles, setups, and how to batch efficiently in one session

Important: my strength is prepared, scripted content and voiceover. Long unscripted talking-head isn't my format. Scripts need to be written for delivery I can actually execute



WHAT YOU EDIT DIRECTLY



Instagram and TikTok Stories,  built from scratch, roughly 15 sales-focused stories a month

Static and photo posts, what to post, how often, how it should look, and the actual edit

Captions, hooks, and CTAs across everything



WHAT YOU COORDINATE, NOT EDIT



Reels and long-form video go to my video editor. You brief them, communicate the creative direction, and review the cut against the script before it goes out. You're the bridge between strategy and the edit , not the one cutting it



UPLOADING & SCHEDULING



Post and schedule everything across both platforms



COMMUNITY & DMs



Reply to DMs and comments in my voice

Summarise recurring themes and questions back to me weekly, that's raw material for content and product

Flag brand inbound and anything that needs my personal reply



MONETISATION & REPORTING



CTAs that route people to DMs, the freebie, and the
 list (once the product is launched)

Track leads and conversions, not vanity metrics

Monthly reporting against those milestones



PLEASE INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION



Your work style — how much direction do you need from me, and where do you prefer to run independently?

Deadlines — what's the cadence for scripts, calendar, and posting, and what do you need from me each week to keep it moving?

Reporting — what do you track, how often do I see it, and what does a monthly report actually look like?

When something isn't working — do you flag it early or wait for the monthly review?

Relevant work — accounts you've grown, ideally in a personal-brand or women's lifestyle space.

Your rate and what's included at that rate.

One idea for my account, based on what you see on it right now.

title: Customer Centered Project Coordinator
description:
RESTORATION BILLING SERVICES



Remote Project Coordinator



Full-Time Position | Restoration and Property-Services Operations



Location



Remote — Philippines



Schedule



Monday–Friday, 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time



Reports To



Operations Manager and Company Ownership



Employment Type



Full-time | Long-term position



Position Summary



The Project Coordinator is responsible for keeping restoration projects organized, documented, scheduled, and moving forward from initial assignment through final billing and closeout. This is not a passive administrative position. The coordinator is expected to communicate confidently, follow up persistently, anticipate delays, and make sure that every customer, crew member, subcontractor, and internal team member knows what happens next.



The successful candidate will be calm under pressure, exceptionally organized, comfortable making and receiving telephone calls, and willing to take ownership of problems until they are resolved. The goal is simple: no missed appointments, no incomplete job files, no unanswered customer questions, and no project left sitting because someone failed to follow up.



Primary Responsibilities



Project Coordination and Scheduling



Coordinate active water, mold, environmental, and restoration projects from initial intake through completion and administrative closeout.



Schedule inspections, mitigation crews, equipment placement and removal, subcontractors, follow-up visits, and customer appointments.



Confirm appointments with customers, property managers, technicians, and subcontractors and immediately address access or scheduling problems.



Maintain an accurate daily and weekly project schedule and communicate changes promptly to everyone affected.



Track project milestones, deadlines, outstanding decisions, and next actions so that work does not stall.



Coordinate closely with the Operations Manager to assign priorities and resolve scheduling conflicts.



Customer and Stakeholder Communication



Serve as a primary point of contact for customers during active projects and provide clear, professional status updates.



Answer incoming calls and make outgoing follow-up calls to customers, property managers, adjusters, attorneys, vendors, and subcontractors.



Respond promptly to questions, complaints, and requests while avoiding promises outside the coordinator's authority.



Communicate difficult information calmly and professionally and escalate serious concerns before they become larger problems.



Document all meaningful conversations, commitments, approvals, and next steps in the CRM immediately after the interaction.



Identify additional customer needs or potential work and promptly refer the opportunity to management or estimating.



CRM, Documentation, and Job-File Control



Create and maintain complete, accurate job records in Luxor CRM and the company's related systems.



Collect and organize signed work authorizations, contracts, photographs, moisture records, inspection reports, estimates, invoices, completion certificates, and other required documentation.



Review job files routinely for missing documents, unclear notes, incomplete tasks, or unresolved follow-ups.



Ensure all
s, telephone notes, reports, and project documents are saved to the correct job file using company naming and filing standards.



Prepare project-status summaries and exception reports for management, highlighting delays, risks, missing information, and decisions required.



Coordinate with bookkeeping so that completed job files contain everything necessary for accurate and timely billing.



Billing, Collections, and Administrative Support



Confirm that project completion documents and billing information are collected and submitted promptly.



Follow up on missing signatures, customer documents, purchase orders, insurance information, and other items delaying billing or payment.



Assist with professional collection calls and
s when assigned; this position requires comfort discussing outstanding invoices.



Help organize attorney correspondence, notices, lien-related information, and supporting documents under management direction.



Maintain accurate follow-up dates and records of collection activity without making unauthorized legal, payment, or settlement commitments.



Operational Follow-Through



Review open projects daily and actively chase missing answers rather than waiting for others to respond.



Identify recurring coordination problems and recommend practical improvements to workflows, templates, checklists, and procedures.



Follow established company procedures while exercising sound judgment when an unusual situation arises.



Participate in project-review meetings and arrive prepared with accurate job status, open issues, and recommended next actions.



Perform other reasonable coordination and administrative duties required to keep company operations running smoothly.



Required Qualifications



At least three years of experience in project coordination, customer service, restoration, construction, property management, logistics, or a similar deadline-driven environment.



Excellent spoken and written English, including the ability to communicate confidently by telephone and write professional
s.



Strong computer skills and the ability to learn CRM, scheduling, telephone, document-management, and Microsoft 365 systems quickly.



Reliable high-speed internet, a professional remote workspace, and backup plans for internet or power interruptions.



Ability to work the full 7:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time schedule consistently.



Stable employment history and a genuine interest in long-term employment with one company.



Preferred Experience



Restoration, construction, insurance, property management, legal support, or service-business coordination experience.



Experience working with U.S. customers and service providers.



Experience using a CRM, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, cloud-based telephone systems, and shared document storage.



Experience coordinating field employees, subcontractors, or multiple active customer projects.



Experience with invoicing follow-up, collections, legal documentation, or lien-support administration.



Personal Characteristics



Ownership: You take responsibility for getting the answer and closing the loop.



Persistence: You follow up professionally and repeatedly without becoming discouraged or abrasive.



Organization: You can manage many moving projects without losing details, deadlines, or documents.



Judgment: You know what you can handle independently and what must be escalated.



Composure: You remain calm, respectful, and productive when customers or situations become difficult.



Accuracy: Your notes, schedules, files, and communications can be relied upon.



Initiative: You look ahead, identify what is missing, and act before someone has to remind you.



Teamwork: You support the field and office teams and do not treat necessary work as beneath you.



Performance Standards



Performance will be evaluated primarily on:



Accuracy and completeness of project files and CRM records.



Timeliness of scheduling, customer responses, documentation, and follow-up.



Number of preventable missed appointments, communication failures, or stalled projects.



Ability to maintain control of multiple open projects and clearly report their status.



Professionalism and effectiveness in customer, vendor, crew, attorney, and collections communications.



Dependability, attendance, adherence to schedule, and long-term commitment.



Authority and Escalation



The Project Coordinator is expected to make routine scheduling and administrative decisions within company procedures. Pricing changes, settlement decisions, legal positions, customer concessions, contractual commitments, and unusual operational risks must be escalated to management before any commitment is made.



Employment Expectations



This is a full-time, long-term position and not a temporary assignment or secondary job.



The employee must be available, responsive, and focused during the entire assigned schedule, except for approved breaks.



Professional appearance and camera participation may be required for video meetings.



Confidential customer, financial, insurance, legal, and company information must be protected at all times.



Continued employment is subject to satisfactory performance during the company's initial probationary period.



Equal Opportunity



Restoration Billing Services considers qualified applicants based on their skills, experience, reliability, and ability to perform the position. The company does not discriminate on the basis of legally protected characteristics.

title: Meta Ad Creative Designer & Copywriter — Paid Test Project (3 Hours)
description:
The Basics

Job type: One test ad. Paid for 3 hours.

Start date: As soon as possible.

Deadline:  3–5 days from brief

Bonus: If this ad is the best one we test, we will offer you ongoing paid work making more ads.



You can split your  hours how you like. For example:



3 hour on research, 2 hours on the ad

Or 2.5 hours on research, 2.5 hours on the ad



Our Brand Look



Our brand is premium and clean. Ads should look bright, sharp, and professional. Think high-end product ad, not a dark or moody lifestyle photo.



Website: 
 



I will send you real photos of our sauna. You can use these. You do not need to find your own.



I can also send you ad creative we have already made. You can use this as a reference only. Please do not copy it. I want your ad to be original work, based on the research you do in Step 1.



Rules — Please Follow These



Do not use medical words. Do not say "clinical," "treats," or "cures." Do not say our sauna treats any illness. This is a wellness product. It is not a medical device. If you use medical words,
 may block the ad.

Use words like: "recovery," "reset," "performance," "built for high achievers." These words fit our brand.

Make it look real. You can use AI tools to improve the photo. But the final image must look like a real photo. It must not look fake or "AI-made." Small changes are better than big changes.

Use our real sauna photos as the base. Do not create a fake sauna from scratch.



Step-by-Step Instructions

 ads need 3 pieces of text. Please write all 3:

Description — This is a small line under the headline. Keep it under 30 characters.

 Primary Text

 Headline

 Description

About Resonance Recovery



Resonance Recovery sells premium infrared saunas in Australia. Our main product is the Recovery Pod, a 2-person full-spectrum infrared sauna.



Who Our Customer Is



Our customer is a high achiever. Think:

People who work out and care about fitness

People who earn over $300,000 a year



They want to look strong. They want to recover fast. They want the best. They do not want anything that looks cheap or fake.

title: Part-Time Video Editor for Product Reviews | YouTube + Amazon
description:
# Part-Time Video Editor for Product Reviews | YouTube + Amazon | $5/Hour



I'm a full-time content creator looking for a reliable **part-time video editor** to help edit my product review videos for **YouTube and Amazon**.



This is a **long-term, ongoing position**, not a one-time project. I'm looking for someone who can learn my editing style and eventually handle my weekly video editing with minimal direction.



**Pay:** $5 USD/hour

**Hours:** Approximately 5–10 hours per week

**Schedule:** Flexible

**Turnaround:** Videos should generally be completed within 72 hours of receiving the footage

**Editing Software:** CapCut Desktop



There is potential for more hours as I increase my content production.



## About My Content



I create **product review and product demonstration videos** for YouTube and Amazon.



My content is straightforward and conversational. I talk about products, demonstrate how they work, show different features, and share my experience using them.



The editing style is **simple, clean, and natural**. I'm not looking for complicated animations, advanced motion graphics, cinematic editing, or lots of effects.



Most of the editing is simply **cutting out mistakes and unnecessary footage**. My YouTube videos also require adding relevant B-roll.



## Typical Weekly Workload



I currently film approximately:



* **15–25 Amazon product review videos per week**

* **1–5 YouTube product review videos per week**



For reference, **this amount of content typically takes me less than 5 hours per week to edit myself.**



I'm hiring an editor because I want to spend less time editing and more time filming, so the amount of content may increase over time.



## YouTube Product Review Videos



**Typical finished length: 5–10 minutes**



Editing mainly includes:



* Cutting out mistakes, pauses, and unnecessary footage

* Making clean cuts so the video flows naturally

* Adding relevant product B-roll throughout the video

* Adding simple text, screenshots, or screen recordings when needed

* Making basic audio adjustments when necessary

* Exporting the finished video



The goal is a clean, natural product review — **not a heavily edited YouTube video.**



## Amazon Product Review Videos



**Typical finished length: 1–3 minutes**



These videos require very simple editing, mainly:



* Cutting out mistakes

* Removing unnecessary pauses or footage

* Combining clips when necessary

* Making sure the video flows naturally

* Basic audio adjustments when necessary

* Exporting the finished video



These videos generally do **not** require B-roll or complicated editing.



## CapCut Desktop



I prefer my videos to be edited using **CapCut Desktop**, so you should already be comfortable and efficient using CapCut.



You should know how to:



* Make clean cuts and remove mistakes quickly

* Add and position B-roll

* Work with multiple video and audio tracks

* Add simple text when needed

* Make basic audio adjustments

* Export videos using the correct settings



You do NOT need advanced editing or animation skills.



## Who I'm Looking For



I'm looking for someone who is:



* Reliable and consistent

* Fast and efficient

* Detail-oriented

* Good at following instructions

* Comfortable using **CapCut Desktop**

* Comfortable editing product reviews and talking-head content

* Able to make clean, natural cuts

* Able to choose and add relevant B-roll

* Organized with video files

* Able to meet deadlines consistently

* Comfortable communicating in English

* Open to feedback and revisions

* Interested in a long-term working relationship



**Reliability, efficiency, communication, and attention to detail are more important to me than fancy editing skills.**



## Hours, Pay & Turnaround



**Pay: $5 USD/hour**



This position will be approximately **5–10 hours per week**, depending on how much content I film.



Your working hours are flexible. However, **assigned videos should generally be completed within 72 hours of receiving the footage.**



If you're unable to meet a deadline for any reason, I expect clear communication ahead of time.



The workload may vary from week to week. As I increase my content production, there is potential for additional hours.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. Tell me a little about yourself and your video editing experience.

2. How long have you been using **CapCut Desktop**?

3. How comfortable are you editing in CapCut?

4. Please send links to **2–3 videos you personally edited**. Product reviews, talking-head videos, or similar creator content are preferred.

5. How many hours per week are you currently available?

6. Do you have experience editing product reviews, YouTube videos, Amazon videos, UGC, or similar content?

7. Are you able to consistently complete assigned edits within **72 hours** of receiving the footage?

8. What is your internet speed and computer setup?

9. Why are you interested in this position?



Please put the word **PURPLE** at the very beginning of your application so I know you read the entire job posting.



Applications that don't include PURPLE or don't answer the questions above may not be considered.



## Paid Trial



Selected applicants will be asked to complete a **small paid editing test** using my footage before I choose someone for the long-term position.



I'm looking for someone dependable who I can work with for a long time. My goal is to eventually be able to send you my footage each week and trust that you'll know my editing style, complete the videos on time, and send them back clean, polished, and ready to use.



If you're looking for consistent part-time editing work and enjoy editing simple product-focused content, I'd love to hear from you!

title: Full-Stack & Integration Developer
description:
Full-Stack & Integration Developer



Next.js / Supabase / Vercel / GoHighLevel



Remote — Philippines preferred

Contract-to-hire | 30–40 hours per week

$8–$15 USD per hour based on demonstrated ability

Six months of confirmed development work



ASC Edge is hiring a full-stack developer to help complete and expand a live field operations and roofing intelligence platform.



We may ultimately hire two developers, but we are beginning by identifying the strongest person capable of understanding the complete system and taking ownership of assigned features.



About ASC Edge



ASC Edge is a field operations platform for roofing contractors—built by a roofer.



The founder spent more than twenty years operating roofing companies before building ASC Edge. We have paying customers, active field users, and a development roadmap funded by real business activity.



This is not a speculative idea or a greenfield prototype. The application exists and contains working features, partially completed features, production defects, and a substantial backlog of new capabilities.



We need someone who can enter an existing codebase, understand how the pieces fit together, finish what has already been started, and build new features that work across the entire platform.



Our technology



* Next.js App Router

* React

* TypeScript

* Supabase Postgres

* Supabase Auth, Storage, Row Level Security, and Edge Functions

* Vercel hosting, deployments, serverless functions, and preview environments

* GoHighLevel CRM, sub-accounts, forms, workflows, webhooks, and messaging

* Stripe subscriptions and seat-based billing

* NOAA/NWS weather data

* Mapping, property, image, document, and third-party APIs

* AI-assisted development tools



What you will do



You will help complete existing features, resolve defects, and build new functionality across the ASC Edge platform.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Working inside an existing Next.js and TypeScript codebase

* Finishing partially completed frontend and backend features

* Building new application features from written requirements

* Connecting application features to Supabase

* Creating and maintaining database tables, migrations, functions, and indexes

* Writing and testing Supabase Row Level Security policies

* Managing authentication, organizations, users, roles, and permissions

* Deploying and troubleshooting applications through Vercel

* Building integrations between ASC Edge and GoHighLevel

* Creating, receiving, validating, and testing webhooks

* Ensuring information reaches the correct organization, user, customer, property, and GHL sub-account

* Converting photographs, documents, inspections, and workflow activity into structured, searchable records

* Writing tests for critical workflows and tenant isolation

* Diagnosing problems that cross several different services

* Reviewing and correcting AI-generated code before it reaches production

* Documenting important technical decisions and integration contracts



You will not be expected to write marketing campaigns or sales copy inside GoHighLevel. However, you must be able to inspect, test, troubleshoot, and complete integrations involving GHL.



A feature is not finished merely because a webhook was sent. It is finished when the correct information reaches the correct destination, produces the intended result, handles failures safely, and can be verified.



Initial development priorities



Our current roadmap includes:



1. Reviewing the existing codebase, database, environments, and integrations

2. Closing incomplete features and known production defects

3. Hardening multi-tenant authentication and organization-level data isolation

4. Completing Supabase RLS policies

5. Completing homeowner-facing property and roof-report features

6. Creating structured event records for photographs, documents, inspections, weather events, and customer activity

7. Completing and documenting integrations between ASC Edge and GHL

8. Building organization, team, and seat-management features

9. Completing Stripe seat-based billing and proration

10. Building limited homeowner authentication and access

11. Completing historical and live weather-data ingestion

12. Adding automated testing, error monitoring, retry handling, and deployment safeguards

13. Building additional features from our six-month product roadmap



Required experience



You should have production experience with most of the following:



* TypeScript

* React

* Next.js

* Supabase

* PostgreSQL

* Authentication and role-based permissions

* Row Level Security

* REST APIs

* Webhooks

* Vercel

* Git and pull-request workflows

* Multi-tenant SaaS applications

* Debugging integrations across multiple systems



You must be able to explain:



* How you prevented one organization from accessing another organization’s data

* How you tested permissions and RLS policies

* How you handled privileged server-side operations

* How you secured webhook endpoints

* How you prevented duplicate webhook processing

* How you debugged a workflow involving multiple services

* What went wrong in a previous project and what you learned from it



Strongly preferred



Experience with any of the following is valuable:



* GoHighLevel APIs, workflows, webhooks, or marketplace applications

* Stripe subscriptions, quantities, proration, and webhook processing

* PostGIS or geospatial data

* Mapping and property-data services

* NOAA, NWS, or other government-data APIs

* Progressive Web Apps

* Offline-capable field applications

* Image or document processing

* Playwright, Vitest, Cypress, or similar testing tools

* Sentry or similar production monitoring

* Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or other AI development tools



How we work



* Direct communication with the founder

* Fast decisions without committees

* Written scopes and acceptance criteria

* Short development cycles

* Weekly releases

* Separate Git branches and pull requests

* Working demonstrations before tasks are considered complete

* Clear ownership of assigned features

* Early communication when something is blocked

* Honest estimates and accurate time reporting



AI development tools are welcome. Unreviewed AI-generated code is not.



We care more about working software, technical judgment, communication, and reliability than degrees or impressive job titles.



Repository access is personal. Undisclosed outsourcing or sharing access with another person will result in immediate termination.



Schedule



This is a remote position requiring 30–40 hours per week.



You do not have to work a complete US shift, but you must maintain at least three hours of overlap with US Central Time on agreed working days.



You must also be available for scheduled planning meetings, feature demonstrations, and occasional production issues.



Compensation



* $8–$15 USD per hour

* Rate determined by experience and paid-trial performance

* 30–40 hours per week after the initial evaluation period

* Approximately six months of confirmed roadmap work

* Opportunity for a longer-term position

* Weekly or biweekly payment on an agreed schedule



Candidates should apply at the rate they genuinely expect to receive. We will not automatically select the lowest bidder.



Paid trial project



Selected applicants will be invited to complete a small, real assignment from the ASC Edge development backlog.



This is paid development work—not a hypothetical coding exercise.



Each assignment will:



* Be limited to approximately 4–6 authorized hours

* Be paid at the candidate’s agreed hourly rate

* Have a maximum number of hours approved before work begins

* Be completed in a development environment on a separate Git branch

* Include written requirements and acceptance criteria

* Produce useful work for ASC Edge

* Be paid upon completion of the authorized assignment, whether or not the candidate is selected for the ongoing role

* Become the property of ASC Edge upon payment



Candidates will not initially receive production database access or unrestricted customer information.



Additional hours must be approved before they are performed.



The completed assignment must include:



* A pull request

* Basic testing

* Concise documentation

* A short recorded walkthrough explaining the work

* Disclosure of material third-party or AI-generated code



We will evaluate:



* Whether the feature actually works

* Ability to understand an existing codebase

* Code quality and readability

* Security and tenant isolation

* Testing and failure handling

* Communication

* Documentation

* Time management

* Technical judgment

* Appropriate review of AI-generated code



The strongest candidate will begin with a 20-hour paid working engagement. If that engagement is successful, the role will increase to 30–40 hours per week.



We may offer a second position after evaluating the paid trial projects and organizing the development backlog.



How to apply



Submit the following through this listing:



1. A short introduction

2. Your requested hourly rate

3. The number of hours you can consistently work each week

4. Your time zone and normal working hours

5. Links to your GitHub, portfolio, or relevant work

6. The most complicated multi-tenant permission system you personally built

7. An integration you built involving three or more services

8. Your specific experience with Supabase and RLS

9. Your experience with GoHighLevel

10. Your experience with Vercel

11. Your experience using AI coding tools

12. Confirmation that you are willing to complete a paid trial project



Begin your application with the words ROOF PASSPORT so we know you read the complete posting.



Do not send a generic cover letter. Specific answers and examples matter more than polished language.

title: Marketing Project Manager for US Agency: Problem Solvers Wanted
description:
I run a US marketing agency with a short, intentional client list: websites, campaigns, ads,
, tracking, funnels, content, social.



I am hiring a Marketing Project Manager. Not an assistant, not a VA, not a junior hire. You would own client relationships end to end, write the plans, hold the dates, and do a large share of the work yourself.



Read the whole post. The application instructions at the bottom are not optional.



WHAT I AM LOOKING FOR



Someone who notices what is missing, not just what is present.



The work changes constantly and I cannot hand you a procedure for most of it. When an instruction has a gap in it, I need you to catch it. When a request contradicts itself, I need you to catch that before the work starts.



Figuring it out means finding the real answer, even if that means asking me or the client. Making it up means guessing and hoping nobody checks. If you do not have what you need, say so, and bring a suggested way forward with you.



One thing is never open to interpretation: the spec. If a client approves specific copy, a specific reference, or a specific layout, we build that, not our better version of it. Initiative here is about how the work gets done. It is not about d
 what the client actually wanted.



THE THREE THINGS WE MEASURE



Every month. Not stretch goals. This is the job.



Communication.
s answered within one business day.

Quality. What we deliver matches the spec the client approved.

Timing. We deliver on the dates we promised.



Dates can move. They move by telling the client early and agreeing a new one, never by missing them. Nobody here kills themselves to absorb work that lands mid-month.



THE TOOLS



New builds and our internal tooling run on Claude and Claude Code. You get a license and use it every day. Existing client sites are WordPress, often built badly by whoever came before us, so that side is more about diagnosing what is actually wrong than being a WordPress expert.



You do not need to be a developer. You need to be resourceful: an AI tool, a search, a support ticket, whatever it actually takes. When you use AI, read and check what comes back. It does not make this work faster here. It makes the result better.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Real experience managing marketing projects and clients, ideally US or Western

- Advanced to fluent English, written and spoken. You will write to my clients under my company's name and be on fast-moving internal Zoom calls

- WordPress familiarity, Elementor and Divi included

- Hands-on experience with a CRM or marketing platform, GoHighLevel preferred

- Real experience using AI tools to build and fix things, not just to write copy

- Marketing judgment: you can tell me why a piece of work is a good idea, not just that it is done

- Stable fast internet, backup power and backup internet

- Long-term intent



SCHEDULE



9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Central, Monday to Friday. That is 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM Manila, shifting one hour in November when US clocks change.



It is a night shift and I will not dress it up. It is a fixed one: no on-call, no rotation, done when your shift ends, and weekends are yours. If you are excellent and this window does not work for you, apply anyway and tell me what does.



TERMS



- 13th month pay, which is not required for contractors here. I pay it anyway

- Increases based on performance, not on asking

- Full-time, long-term independent contractor. Reviews at 3, 6 and 12 months

- A live Zoom interview, then a paid test project on real work that I pay for either way

- I train you myself



The person who applies must be the same person who interviews and does the job. No proxy interviews, no delegated fulfillment.



HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)



Start your message with the word: SPEC



Then write one
. A client
s you on a Monday asking for updates to an existing landing page. They send:



- A link to their current landing page

- A screenshot of another landing page they like

- A note that it needs to be live Friday, because their ad campaign starts that day

- A mention that their designer will send the new product photos "sometime next week"



Write the
 you would send back before starting any work. A few short paragraphs is plenty.



Then answer:



1. A specific time you noticed something was wrong, missing, or about to go wrong when it was not your job and nobody asked you to look. What did you do, and what happened?

2. A time you had to deliver something you did not already know how to do. Not "I asked my manager." What did you actually do to figure it out?

3. What have you built or fixed using AI tools, and which ones? Be specific.



Also include your resume, your expected monthly rate, whether the schedule works for you long term, and a short voice note or video telling me why this role interests you and what you would want to know about it.



Applications that do not follow these instructions will not be reviewed.

title: AI-enabled video editor | Premiere Pro plus Claude plus CLI editing, responsible for systems and agent orchestration
description:
Fast-growing DTC brand spending six figures a month on Meta + TikTok paid media. High creative velocity is the whole game for us. Every week we test more angles, more hooks, more formats, more variants than most brands do in a quarter. Our creative team right now is one person, the founder. It's the bottleneck. Time to fix it.



THE ROLE



You'll own creative production for the brand end-to-end. Your primary tools are Claude (with agent instructions we hand you) and the full Higgsfield suite (image + video generation). We have a system of AI agents with markdown-file instructions that generate first-draft creatives. Your job:

- Receive the AI-generated creatives, verify quality, edit the mistakes in Premiere Pro, ship the final files.

- Improve the agent markdown instructions over time so first drafts get sharper every week.

- Handle the manual touch-up editing that AI still can't fully deliver (color, timing, brand consistency, captions).

- Train the AI on our editing process as you grow the position.



We're targeting about 2,000 creatives per month. Mix of:

- Statics (brand graphics, review-based, comparison, offer variants)

- Short-form video (30 to 60 seconds vertical, TikTok + Reels + Shorts)

- Motion graphics and animated concepts

- UGC re-cuts from raw source footage

- Founder-video re-cuts into ad units



Not all AI-generated, not all manual, a hybrid workflow you'll own.



WHAT WE'LL HAND YOU ON DAY ONE



- Full Higgsfield account access (Soul 2.0, Seedance, Veo 3, Kling, Nano Banana, Marketing Studio, the whole suite).

- Claude API keys and Claude Code CLI installed on your machine.

- Current agent markdown files (content guidelines, brand voice, format rules, hook templates, safe zones) that our agents run on.

- Full brand asset library (fonts, logos, product shots, past winning creatives, footage archive).

- Direct line to the founder for anything needing brand-level input.

- A weekly Friday sync (30 minutes on Zoom) to review what shipped, what won, what's next.



WHAT YOU SHOULD ALREADY HAVE (NOT NEGOTIABLE)



- Adobe Premiere Pro fully licensed and running on your machine. You're fast in it, keyboard-shortcut fluent, comfortable with multi-cam, motion, and colour.

- Claude Pro subscription (or higher) already active. You use it daily, not weekly.

- A visual code editor installed (Visual Studio Code, Cursor, or Windsurf). You're comfortable opening a project folder and editing markdown or config files without needing hand-holding.

- CLI fluency. You can navigate the terminal, run git commands, run shell scripts, install Node or Python packages, install our render pipeline. You're not scared of the command line.

- A working Claude workflow with trained .md agent files ready to deploy. You already build your own agents or skills for creative work. When we hand you our brand's agent markdown files, you know exactly what to do with them (drop into your agents folder, read the frontmatter, extend them, wire them to your tools).

- Familiarity with receiving markdown files and building context from them. A big part of this role is being handed a five-page brand brief in markdown and instantly turning it into a repeatable creative workflow. If markdown-as-instructions is new to you, this role is a bad fit.



REQUIREMENTS



- 3+ years hands-on Adobe Premiere Pro at a professional level. Not just "I've used it." You edit in Premiere daily and are fast enough that mouse-clicking through menus feels slow to you.

- After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or Cavalry for the motion-graphics slice of the work.

- Comfortable with generative AI tools. Higgsfield, Runway, ChatGPT / Claude, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, similar. You've shipped work using at least three of these in production.

- Established Claude Pro workflow. You already use Claude daily to speed up creative work, have trained agent .md files of your own, and can hit the ground running with ours.

- CLI + code-editor fluency. You can run git clone, install a Node render pipeline, open a repo in VS Code / Cursor / Windsurf, edit markdown files, and use our tools without weekly hand-holding.

- Strong eye for brand consistency and short-form ad pacing. You can tell within 3 seconds whether a hook lands and why.

- Reliable high-speed internet + a Mac or PC that can edit 4K video smoothly. Hard floor is 16 GB RAM. Strong preference for 64 GB+ RAM (real edge on this hire, say so explicitly in your application if you have it). Dedicated GPU strongly preferred. Premiere runs without hiccups on your machine.

- Strong written English. Agent instructions are written in English and clarity in your own docs matters.

- Ownership mindset. You're going to RUN this function, not just execute tickets from a queue.



NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED BUT A BIG PLUS)



- Claude Code CLI experience specifically (not just claude.ai in the browser).

- Git + GitHub basics. Pull, branch, PR, resolve a simple conflict.

- Meta / TikTok Ads Manager familiarity. You won't be buying media, but knowing what actually wins on those platforms helps you edit smarter.

- Previous experience training or fine-tuning AI agents or prompts at real production scale.

- Previous DTC or e-commerce creative work (Shopify brands, DTC apparel, DTC food or beverage, DTC beauty).

- Motion graphics chops (After Effects, Cavalry, Rive, Lottie).

- Photoshop / Figma for the static side.

- Screen-recording + auto-caption tooling (Remotion, WhisperX, LR-ASD, similar).



GROWTH PATH



- Month 1 to 3: you solo, learning our system, hitting the 2,000 per month volume with our support.

- Month 3 to 6: you start hiring 1 to 2 junior editors under you (we fund the roles), you review and ship their work.

- Month 6 to 12: you're the Head of Creative Production for the brand, with 2 to 4 editors on your team, you own the whole engine.



WHY THIS ROLE IS UNUSUAL



Most editor jobs give you a queue of source files and ask you to render them. This one asks you to work WITH AI as a co-editor, improve the AI's output through prompt and agent iteration, and eventually train a small team under you. If you love editing AND you're already using AI daily, this is the role you've been waiting for.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a message with all of the following. If any are missing, we'll skip your application.



1. Link to your best Premiere Pro portfolio. 3 to 5 pieces you're most proud of, ideally short-form ad work. Include the raw source and your final render if possible so we can see your editing decisions.



2. Which AI tools you use DAILY and how. 2 to 3 sentences per tool. Be specific. "I use Higgsfield Soul 2.0 for photoreal humans, Runway Gen-3 Turbo for motion, and Claude Pro with a set of 4 trained agents for scripting" beats "I use AI."



3. Screenshot or link to your own .md agent files. If you already have trained Claude agents or Claude Code skills you've built, send one or two so we can see how you structure them. This is the biggest differentiator in this hire.



4. Confirm your local stack. What code editor you use (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf), whether Claude Pro is active, whether Premiere Pro is licensed and installed, whether you've used Claude Code CLI, and your machine specs (total RAM, GPU, CPU, whether you edit 4K natively without proxies). If you have 64 GB+ RAM, put it in bold at the top of your reply, it moves you up the pile.



5. Your monthly salary expectation in USD (be specific, not a range).



6. Your time zone and preferred working hours.



Put "Premiere + Claude Pro Editor" in the subject / first line so I know you actually read this.



Looking forward to seeing your work. 



Pay is flexible between $5 all the way up to skill set matching... Negotiable. 



You will be expected to show your workflow during the discovery call, including how you expedite creatives and cut editing time with your agents that you have set up in your virtual code editor/Claude in conjunction with your CLI

description:
REVENUE CYCLE MANAGEMENT SPECIALIST



Job Title: Revenue Cycle Management Specialist (Non-US)

Location: 100% Remote (Offshore)

Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor

Compensation: $700-$2,000 

Hours: 40 hours/week, primarily EST business hours

Reports to: Operations / Revenue Cycle Lead



About Josi Health

Josi Health is a fast-growing remote healthcare company focused on making neurodivergent care (including evaluations & therapy) more accessible, faster, and less stressful for families. We operate across 40+ states and work with major insurance carriers. Every claim we submit correctly means another family gets care without billing delays.



About the Role

We are looking for a detail-obsessed Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to own the full claims lifecycle – from claim submission and scrubbing to payment posting, AR follow-up, and denial resolution. You will ensure that every claim is submitted accurately, every denial is challenged, and every payment is reconciled.



This is not a passive billing role. You will be the person who catches errors before claims go out, follows up relentlessly on unpaid claims, and identifies patterns that prevent denials from happening in the first place. If you hate leaving money on the table and enjoy the puzzle of resolving claim discrepancies, you will thrive here.



Key Responsibilities



Billing and Claims Submission

- Prepare, review, and submit accurate claims to commercial payers (e.g., Aetna, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield, UnitedHealthcare, Optum)

- Verify and ensure the accuracy of billing codes (CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10) and modifiers for services rendered, with a focus on behavioral health and virtual care codes

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of commercial insurance billing requirements, with a focus on behavioral health and telehealth regulations

- Use billing software and clearinghouses to process and track claims

- Ensure timely filing requirements are met for all assigned payers



Accounts Receivable Management

- Monitor claim status and follow up on unpaid, underpaid, and denied claims promptly

- Investigate and resolve claim discrepancies, denials, and appeals

- Submit corrected claims and appeals when necessary

- Maintain AR aging across assigned payer relationships – work buckets by age and priority

- Review EOBs and denial trends to identify recurring issues and root causes

- Generate reports for outstanding accounts receivable and payment trends



Payment Posting and Reconciliation

- Post insurance and patient payments accurately (manual and electronic)

- Reconcile ERA/EOB payments against expected reimbursement

- Identify and resolve underpayments, overpayments, and credit balances

- Process refunds to insurance and patients in compliance with regulations



Compliance and Documentation

- Ensure all billing practices comply with federal, state, and local regulations

- Verify patient insurance information, eligibility, and prior authorization requirements

- Maintain accurate records of billing activities and patient accounts

- Follow HIPAA regulations to ensure patient confidentiality

- Support internal audits and quality reviews as requested



Communication and Coordination

- Collaborate with office staff, clinical teams, and payers to address billing and reimbursement issues

- Proactive about providing feedback to benefits verification team to ensure upfront accurate patient out of pocket estimates

- Provide clear communication to patients regarding their billing, payments, and financial responsibilities

- Respond to inquiries from payers, patients, and colleagues in a professional and timely manner

What We're Looking For



Must-Have

- 2+ years of experience in medical billing, AR follow-up, claims processing, or revenue cycle operations

- Experience with claim clearinghouses and payer portals

title: Construction - Graphic Design for Architectural Product Specification Sheets
description:
BSP Australia — Contractor Brief

Product Specification & Technical Data Sheet Project — Scope of Work



1. Company & Project Background

BSP Australia is a car park fit-out and refurbishment company. We import and supply the full range of car park safety and infrastructure products covered in this brief — bike racks, bollards, wheel stops, speed humps, height bars, corner guards, downpipe guards, rumble bars, convex mirrors, sign posts, entry matting, stair nosing, and tactile ground surface indicators.



Our existing product documentation is inconsistent, outdated, or incomplete. We are engaging a contractor to produce a complete, professional, technically accurate Specification Sheet and Technical Data / Maintenance & Care Sheet for every product in our range, built to BSP's new branded template.



2. Objective & Quality Standard

Deliverables must be produced to an architect-specification level of quality — the standard architects, engineers, and specifiers expect when selecting and installing commercial products.

Technically precise data only: exact dimensions, materials, load ratings, and standards compliance — no approximations or placeholder values.

Clean, professional layout, fully consistent with BSP's new branded template.

High-resolution product photography, cropped and retouched for a polished, consistent look across the whole range.

Clear construction drawings/diagrams showing dimensions and fixing details.

Final output must be high-quality, print-ready PDFs.



3. Scope of Work — Deliverables Per Product

Two documents are required for every product (SKU):



Specification Sheet — construction drawing, dimensions, weight, product photos, fixing type & method, slip rating (where applicable), warranty, size, colour, applicable AS/NZS standard, luminance contrast, and standard size/length.

Technical Data / Maintenance & Care Sheet — care instructions, cleaning instructions, maintenance schedule, and warranty terms.

Note: slip rating only applies where slip resistance is a relevant safety characteristic (e.g. entry matting, stair nosing, tactile indicators); this is flagged in the tracking workbook.



4. Project Volume & Priority

Total SKUs in scope: 74

Priority SKUs (complete first): 58

Standard-priority SKUs: 16

Total documents to produce (2 per SKU): 148

Covers 13 product categories: bike racks, bollards, wheel stops, speed humps, height bars, corner guards, downpipe guards, rumble bars, convex mirrors, sign posts, entry matting, stair nosing, and tactile indicators.



Products marked ? Priority in the Products Data Required tab should be completed first; Standard-priority products can follow in any order.



5. Required Skills & Experience

Graphic design proficiency in Canva or a similar tool, with a portfolio showing clean, professional technical/spec-sheet style layouts.

Ability to produce and export high-resolution, print-ready PDF documents.

Strong attention to technical detail — comfortable reading and interpreting product drawings, dimensions, and specifications, and sourcing missing data accurately.

Experience with construction, building products, architectural, or technical specification documentation is highly regarded.

Familiarity with relevant AS/NZS standards (e.g. AS 4586 slip resistance, AS 1428.4.1 tactile indicators) is an advantage; accurate sourcing and verification of standards references is required regardless.

Highly organised — able to work systematically through a 74+ SKU product list and track progress in a shared spreadsheet.



6. Reference Material Provided

The following will be provided as a starting point — treat as reference only, not a final answer. Much of it is outdated, incomplete, or inconsistently branded and will need to be verified, reshot, or re-sourced:



Existing warranty & care documentation — inconsistent quality, needs reformatting to the new brand standard.

Existing technical data sheets — mostly current and accurate, need rebranding and standardising.

Product photos — from a previous, incomplete attempt at photographing the range.

General product info folder — a mix of old and current material, needs sorting.

Google Photos shared album of additional product images (access on request).

Example spec sheets from competitor TSA — a strong benchmark for layout and content.

Example spec sheets from competitor Northpac — an acceptable benchmark.



7. Workflow & Tools

The contractor will work from a shared Excel tracking workbook with three tabs:



Products Data Required — full SKU list with scope flags per product (which deliverables and data fields are required for each item).

Spec Sheet Requ Check List — the working checklist; one row per product with a tickbox for each required data field, plus a status dropdown (Not Started / In Progress / Complete / Reviewed) to track progress.

Supporting Info and Data — links to the reference folders and source material described above.

The contractor should tick off each field as it is sourced/completed and keep the status columns up to date so progress can be tracked centrally.



8. File Naming, Submission & Branding

Completed files must be saved to BSP's shared OneDrive folder, follow BSP's file naming convention, and be built on BSP's new branded template. These three details are being finalised and will be confirmed before work begins.



9. Engagement Details (BSP to complete before issuing)

Estimated timeline / delivery schedule: [TBD]

Budget / rate structure: [TBD]

Point of contact: [TBD]

Review & sign-off process: [TBD]

title: Executive Assistant / Marketing Operations Assistant
description:
Executive Assistant / Marketing Operations Assistant



I’m looking for a highly capable right-hand assistant to help me with a mix of marketing support, admin, digital implementation, website updates, content updates, reporting, and project coordination.



This is not just a basic admin role.



I need someone who is organised, proactive, detail-oriented, tech-comfortable, reliable, and good at getting things done. A big part of this role is helping take work off my plate. I will often set the direction or explain the outcome I want, and I need someone who can help turn that into action, implementation, follow-up and completion.



This is a long-term role for the right person.



The kind of work involved



You may be helping with things like:



working with Infusionsoft/Keap (creating automations,
 broadcasts, tagging, reporting, etc) 

updating WordPress pages

making edits in Elementor or similar page builders

updating newsletters and
 broadcasts

uploading and formatting content

updating online course and membership content

helping with CRM and automation tasks

pulling together reports and simple dashboards

checking pages,
s, links and member areas for errors

documenting systems and creating checklists

turning rough notes or voice notes into action steps

following up freelancers, contractors or specialists

helping keep projects organised and moving forward

Important skills



A strong advantage for this role is experience with:



Keap / Infusionsoft

WordPress

Elementor

LearnDash

Memberium

 marketing systems

spreadsheets / reporting

project management tools

digital marketing support

online course or membership platforms



Hands-on Keap / Infusionsoft experience is strongly preferred, because it will be a useful part of this role.



If you have used Keap / Infusionsoft before, please explain exactly what tasks you handled inside the platform.



Examples:



broadcasts

tags

campaigns

contact records

list segmentation

automation support

admin and cleanup



You do not need to know every platform already, but you do need to be smart, quick to learn, resourceful, calm, and comfortable figuring things out.



You’ll likely be a great fit if you:

are very organised

have strong written English

follow through well

notice details

take ownership

are proactive

can work independently

are comfortable with tech and online systems

like improving systems and making things smoother

can work from an outcome, not just step-by-step instructions



This role is probably not for you if:

you need constant supervision

you miss small details

you dislike learning new tools

you are slow to follow up

you prefer repetitive admin only

you wait to be told every tiny step

Hours and pay



Part-time to start: 20 to 25 hours per week

Rate: USD $6 to $8 per hour depending on experience, skill level, and fit

For candidates with strong relevant experience, especially with Keap / Infusionsoft, I’m open to paying toward the higher end.



This role can grow into a bigger long-term role for the right person.



To apply



Please send:



a short introduction about yourself

your relevant experience

the tools/platforms you know best

your specific Keap / Infusionsoft experience, if any

examples of similar work you have done

your availability each week

your ideal hourly rate

a short Loom video introducing yourself

the word Harbour at the top of your application so I know you read everything carefully



I’m looking for someone practical, switched-on, reliable, and easy to work with. If that sounds like you, I’d love to hear from you.

title: AI Marketing Fulfillment Lead
description:
Digital Transformations AI is hiring a reliable fulfillment specialist to help us launch and support marketing systems for real estate professionals.



You’ll initially work alongside our founder and fulfillment lead, completing clearly assigned client work. As you learn our systems, the goal is for you to eventually own the launch and ongoing fulfillment of an entire real estate client package—from the initial AI Blueprint and onboarding through website, CRM,
 marketing, social media, and launch.



Real estate experience is strongly preferred, but not required. We care most about your ability to learn our systems, follow instructions, take ownership, and consistently finish high-quality work.



THE WORK

GoHighLevel and CRM

• Set up and organize client GoHighLevel subaccounts

• Build pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, funnels, and landing pages

• Configure workflows,
 and SMS campaigns, triggers, and automations

• Import and organize contacts, tags, custom fields, and opportunities

• Test every part of the system before launch

Websites and Funnels

• Build websites and funnels in GoHighLevel

• Use AI-assisted website builders to create initial layouts and prototypes

• Build or finish websites in WordPress

• Work from our approved briefs, examples, copy, and brand guidelines

• Make revisions and complete pre-launch quality checks



Real Estate Marketing Fulfillment

• Create and schedule social media content

• Prepare monthly real estate
 newsletters

• Build buyer, seller, expired, probate, and database nurture campaigns

• Update property, market, and agent information when needed

• Help maintain consistent marketing across each client’s website, CRM,
, and social channels



Client Launches

As you grow into the role, you will help manage complete launches:

• Review the client’s AI Blueprint and fulfillment plan

• Organize the required assets and information

• Track every deliverable using our checklists and systems

• Coordinate work with our internal team

• Build, test, revise, and prepare the client’s systems for launch

• Help manage ongoing monthly fulfillment after launch



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

• Hands-on GoHighLevel experience

• Experience building websites or funnels in GHL or WordPress

• Comfortable creating and scheduling social media content

• Able to build
 campaigns and basic CRM automations

• Strong attention to detail and quality control

• Excellent written English and communication

• Self-directed, dependable, and comfortable asking questions

• Able to follow a detailed brief, checklist, and established process

• Interested in taking greater ownership as you learn the role



REAL ESTATE EXPERIENCE IS A PLUS

Experience supporting a real estate agent, team, brokerage, investor, or marketing company would be especially valuable.



Helpful knowledge includes:

• Real estate lead generation and follow-up

• Buyer and seller pipelines

• Listings and property marketing

• Monthly database newsletters

• Expired, probate, FSBO, or sphere campaigns

• Real estate social media content

• CRM database organization and nurture

You do not need real estate experience if you are a strong builder who is willing and able to learn.



WHAT YOU DON’T NEED

• Advanced custom coding experience

• Responsibility for strategy on day one

• Direct client management when you first start

• Knowledge of every part of the role before applying



We have systems, templates, briefs, examples, and training. We need someone who can learn them, execute carefully, and gradually take ownership.



THE OPPORTUNITY

This is intended to become a long-term position.



You will begin by supporting our existing fulfillment team. The right person can grow into owning the complete launch and ongoing fulfillment of assigned real estate clients from start to finish.



We are looking for someone who wants responsibility, consistency, and an opportunity to become an important part of our team—not someone looking for occasional short-term projects.



TO APPLY

Please include:



1. Two or three examples of GoHighLevel funnels, websites, automations, or WordPress sites you have completed.

2. Any experience you have working with real estate agents or real estate marketing.

3. Your strongest skills among GoHighLevel, WordPress,
 marketing, automation, and social media.

4. Your weekly availability and preferred working hours.

5. A brief example of a project you personally took from assignment through completion.

6. The phrase “Real Estate Fulfillment” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full post.



We’re hiring immediately and will begin with a paid trial project.



JOB DETAILS

• More than 30 hours per week

• Long-term position: more than six months

• Intermediate experience level

• Starting rate: $4 per hour

• Opportunity for increased responsibility and compensation based on performance

title: Customer Support Specialist (Shopify Dropshipping)
description:
Salary: $600 USD/month



Schedule: Monday–Friday | 40 Hours per Week (Full-Time)





About Us



We are a fast-growing Shopify dropshipping company specializing in men’s apparel.



We’re looking for an experienced Senior Customer Support Specialist who understands the fast-paced world of Shopify dropshipping and can confidently manage customer support while protecting the company’s profitability.



This is NOT an entry-level position.



We are looking for someone with at least 4-5 years minimum (DO NOT APPLY IF LESS) of hands-on Shopify dropshipping customer support experience who enjoys solving problems, communicating professionally, and taking ownership of customer issues.





Your Responsibilities



As our Senior Customer Support Specialist, you will:



* Respond to customer
s professionally using Gmail

* Deliver friendly, natural, and professional customer support (never robotic)

* Resolve customer issues quickly while protecting company profitability

* Track orders and investigate delayed, lost, or undelivered shipments

* Communicate directly with suppliers regarding shipping updates, replacements, and stock availability

* Take immediate action when products become out of stock

* Work closely with your manager to resolve complex customer situations

* Help reduce refunds and chargebacks through excellent customer communication

* Process replacements, refunds, and other resolutions according to our company SOPs

* Keep Google Sheets and tracking documents updated

* Use ChatGPT to improve
 quality while keeping every response natural and personalized

* Stay organized while handling a high volume of customer
s

* Identify recurring customer issues and communicate them to management





Required Experience



We’re looking for someone with real Shopify dropshipping customer support experience.



Minimum requirements:



* 4-5 + years of Shopify dropshipping customer support experience

* Experience supporting Shopify stores through Gmail

* Strong experience using Shopify Admin

* Experience communicating with suppliers

* Experience using Google Sheets

* Excellent written English

* Strong problem-solving skills

* Excellent organization and attention to detail

* Ability to remain calm under pressure

* Ability to work independently and make good decisions

* Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT to improve customer communication





Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



* Men’s clothing or fashion brands

* High-volume Shopify stores

* Chargeback prevention

* Refund management

* Order tracking and shipping issue resolution

* Communicating with Chinese suppliers





Please DO NOT Apply If



This position is for experienced Shopify dropshipping customer support professionals only.



Please do not apply if:



* You have less than 2 years of Shopify dropshipping customer support experience.

* You have never supported customers for a Shopify dropshipping store.

* You have never used Gmail as your primary customer support platform.

* You have never communicated directly with suppliers.

* You immediately refund customers without investigating the situation.

* You struggle to stay calm when dealing with angry customers.

* You are uncomfortable handling a high volume of customer
s.

* You are not organized.

* Your written English is not at a professional level.

* You are looking for basic customer support training.



We are looking for someone who can quickly learn our internal SOPs and become a valuable long-ter
mber of our team.





Equipment Requirements



You must have:



* A reliable laptop or desktop computer

* A smartphone (Apple devices preferred)

* Reliable high-speed internet

* A quiet workspace suitable for full-time remote work





Required Application Questions



Please answer every question.



Applications with incomplete or low-effort answers will not be reviewed.



1.



How many years have you worked in Shopify dropshipping customer support?



Describe the types of stores you have supported.





2.



Approximately how many customer
s have you handled in a single day while maintaining quality?





3.

Walk us through exactly how you would handle this situation.

What are the first steps you would take?

In your opinion, what is the best way to keep refunds and chargebacks as low as possible while still providing excellent customer service?

What happened, and what did you learn from it?





7.



How do you use ChatGPT to improve your customer
s while ensuring they still sound personal and professional?

Describe your experience.





9.

10.



Why do you believe you’re the right person to support customers for a high-volume Shopify dropshipping business?





We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers, solves problems quickly, communicates professionally, takes ownership of their work, and understands that excellent customer service means protecting both the customer experience and the long-term success of the business.

title: GHL & WordPress Website Builder + Social Media Content
description:
Digital Transformations AI is hiring a skilled builder to join our fulfillment team. You'll execute website builds in GoHighLevel and WordPress, manage AI Studio automations, and produce templated social media content for our clients. You'll work from detailed briefs and systems we've built—your job is to execute to spec, not to invent.



THE WORK:

Website Builds (Primary Focus)

• Build client websites in GoHighLevel using AI Studio to design and prototype the experience.

• Migrate or port GHL builds into WordPress and finish the site build there.

• Work from design briefs and brand guidelines we provide.



Social Media Content (Secondary)

• Learn our content process and expand on it (we'll train you on the system).

• Manage scheduling and publishing across platforms.

• Work from content calendars and brand guidelines we've locked in.

• AI Studio fluency—can build and configure workflows and automations (no custom coding required).

• WordPress development skills—can build pages, customize templates, integrate with tools.

• Social media content creation—can design simple graphics, write copy, schedule posts.

• Comfortable working from detailed briefs and systems (execution, not design decision making).

• Self directed and reliable—you get a task, understand the spec, and ship it.



What You Don't Need:



• Custom code or coding experience (we handle integrations).

• Direct client communication (everything goes through our team leads first).

• Design or strategy decisions (we lock those; you execute).



THE ROLE: This is a fulfillment position. You're the executor behind our builds. You work on our timeline, from our briefs, to our spec. You ship work that we QA and deliver to clients.



TO APPLY:

title: Remote Vibe Coder
description:
Employment Type: 6-Month Contract, Renewable

Working Arrangement: Fully Remote

Working Hours: Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Singapore Time)

Public Holidays: Singapore Public Holiday Calendar



About the Role

We are looking for a Vibe Coder to join our team on a 6-month renewable contract. The ideal candidate is comfortable using modern development tools, AI-assisted coding platforms, and different technologies to rapidly build, test, deploy and maintain web, mobile and other software applications.



This role is suitable for someone who enjoys solving problems, experimenting with new technologies, turning ideas into working solutions, and learning quickly.



You will work closely with our team to develop and improve software solutions, troubleshoot issues, perform QA testing, and support deployment across different environments.



Key Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain web, mobile and other software applications based on project requirements.

- Use AI-assisted coding / vibe coding tools to accelerate development and improve productivity.

- Participate in an Agile development environment, including sprint planning, development, testing and iteration.

- Translate business requirements and ideas into practical technical solutions.

- Perform QA testing, debugging and troubleshooting before and after deployment.

- Deploy and maintain applications across relevant environments, including web servers, cloud platforms, mobile platforms and other application environments.

- Work with APIs, databases, third-party services and integrations where required.

- Assist with the development and integration of IoT devices, sensors, GPS trackers and other connected devices.

- Identify technical issues, investigate root causes and implement effective solutions.

- Maintain clear documentation of development, deployment and technical processes.

- Continuously research and learn new technologies, development frameworks and AI tools.



Requirements

-Technical Skills

- Experience in web application development.

- Basic to intermediate knowledge of mobile application development is an advantage.

- Ability to deploy and maintain web, mobile and other types of applications.

- Familiarity with databases, APIs and third-party integrations.

- Experience with Git/version control and basic software development practices.

- Knowledge of cloud hosting, servers or deployment platforms.

- Basic knowledge of IoT devices, GPS trackers, sensors or connected devices.

- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools is highly desirable.

- Understanding of QA, testing, debugging and troubleshooting.

- Knowledge of Agile/Scrum development methodologies.



Soft Skills

- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

- Able to understand requirements and independently find solutions.

- Fast learner with the ability to adapt to new technologies.

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.

- Detail-oriented and committed to delivering working solutions.

- Willing to experiment, learn and continuously improve.



What We Are Looking For

- The successful candidate does not necessarily need to know every programming language or framework.

- We are looking for someone who can figure things out.

- If you are the type of developer who can take an idea, research the appropriate technology, use AI tools effectively, build a working prototype, test it, deploy it and troubleshoot issues along the way, you may be a good fit for this role.



How to Apply

- Please submit your CV/resume together with your portfolio, GitHub profile or examples of applications/projects you have developed.

- We value practical skills, problem-solving ability and the ability to deliver working solutions over certifications alone.

title: Tiktok Shop Manager
description:
About Us



Thrive Creators is a creator commerce agency. We run TikTok Shop and affiliate programs for creator-led brands in the US — homesteading, cooking, home and kitchen. Our clients sell cookbooks and kitchen products to audiences that already trust them, and our job is to turn that trust into repeatable revenue.



We're small, fast, and we don't do busywork. If something isn't moving GMV, we kill it.



The Role



You'll own the affiliate program for our flagship client account end to end, and eventually across multiple client shops. Finding creators, vetting them, reaching out, managing the sample queue, chasing creators who went quiet, and making sure the affiliates on our roster are actually posting and actually converting.



This is not a "send 200 templated DMs a day" job. Volume outreach is already handled. This role is judgment: d
 who's worth a sample, who's worth a bigger commission, and who's burning our budget.



Remote, full-time, based in the Philippines.



What You'll Do

Search TikTok Shop's Creator Center and affiliate marketplace for creators who fit our clients — home cooking, baking, sourdough, homesteading, family kitchen, rural lifestyle

Vet creator profiles before approving samples — GMV history, recent video performance, audience quality, comment sentiment, and whether their audience actually buys

Manage the full sample request queue: approve, reject, or message. Reject sample farmers on sight

Run outreach and follow-up for qualified creators, and re-activate affiliates who received product and never posted

Source and recruit creators for TikTok Live selling

Watch what's working on the shop and feed creators specific hooks, formats, and angles — not generic "post more" advice

Track affiliate performance weekly, flag top performers for higher commission tiers or Target Collaboration deals, and flag concentration risk when too much GMV sits with one creator

Keep everything logged in Notion so the account is legible to the rest of the team

What We're Looking For

Hands-on experience with TikTok Shop Seller Center and Creator Center — affiliate invitations, open vs. target collaborations, sample requests, creator messaging

Experience managing an affiliate roster for a real shop (not just outreach, actual roster management)

Strong eye for content — you should be able to watch three of a creator's videos and tell us whether they can move product

Experience sourcing or managing TikTok Live sellers is a strong plus

Excellent written English. You'll be messaging US creators daily and representing our clients' brands

Self-directed and organized — you'll run a daily queue without anyone chasing you

Comfortable with at least 4 hours of overlap with US business hours

Bonus: experience with Shopify affiliate tools (UpPromote or similar), or using Claude / AI tools for research and outreach

Compensation

Fixed monthly rate, paid in USD (discussed based on experience)

Performance bonus tied to affiliate GMV

Paid monthly, on time, every time

Hours



Full-time, with required overlap with US hours.



To Apply — Complete This Task First



Applications without these will not be reviewed. Paste your answers directly in your application. No cover letter.



Task 1: Diagnose These Affiliates



Three affiliates from a client shop selling cookbooks and kitchen products to a home-cooking audience. Tell us what you see and exactly what you'd do.



Affiliate 1: 



480,000 followers

Average video views: 38,000

Videos posted for us: 2

Total GMV generated for our shop: $9,100

Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $3,200

Status: Hasn't posted for us in 3 months



Affiliate 2: 



21,000 followers (growing fast)

Videos posted for us: 41 | Lives: 3

Total GMV for our shop: $14,800

Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $48,000

Content quality: high

Status: Requested a second sample 6 weeks ago. Received it. Never posted.



Affiliate 3: 



34,000 followers (growing fast)

Videos posted for us: 162

Total GMV for our shop: $6,900 (~$43 per video)

Platform-wide GMV (last 30 days): $79,000

Content quality: very high

Average video views: 810

Status: Posts constantly. Barely converts.



For each affiliate:



What's actually going on here? Your honest read.

What would you do next? Be specific — not "follow up," but what you'd actually do and why.

Write the exact message you'd send them right now.



Then one more question:



Across this shop, 61% of affiliate GMV comes from a single creator. What's the risk, and what would you do about it over the next 90 days? (Note: AI Generated Answers are very easy to tell, we are looking for very specific things that illustrate your creative thinking)
