title: Maintenance Coordinator
description:
Job Summary 



We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and customer-focused Maintenance Coordinator to oversee and coordinate day-to-day maintenance operations across our managed residential properties. This role serves as the primary liaison between tenants, maintenance technicians, vendors, and property management, ensuring maintenance requests are handled efficiently from initial report through completion. 



The Maintenance Coordinator is responsible for scheduling repairs, monitoring work order progress, communicating with tenants, coordinating vendors, tracking maintenance performance, and ensuring excellent customer service throughout the repair process. 



In addition to coordinating repairs, the Maintenance Coordinator should possess a solid understanding of basic residential maintenance and troubleshooting. This individual will be expected to guide tenants through simple maintenance solutions when appropriate, helping resolve minor issues quickly and reducing unnecessary service calls. 



The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, and possesses excellent communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Experience with property management software and maintenance operations is highly preferred. 



 



Key Responsibilities: 



Maintenance Coordination 

       Receive, review, prioritize, and assign maintenance work orders to maintenance technicians.  

       Coordinate technician schedules to ensure timely completion of repairs and service requests.  

       Monitor active work orders and proactively follow up on pending or overdue tasks.  

       Communicate with technicians regarding job progress, delays, required materials, and completion of updates.  

       Ensure completed work orders include accurate notes, photos (when applicable), and proper documentation before    closing.  

       Escalate emergency maintenance requests to the appropriate personnel for immediate action.  

       Coordinate preventative maintenance schedules to minimize future maintenance issues.  





 Tenant Communication 

        Serve as the primary point of contact for tenants regarding maintenance concerns and repair requests.  

        Respond promptly and professionally via phone,
, Microsoft Teams, and other communication platforms.  

        Schedule maintenance appointments and provide tenants with repair timelines and updates.  

        Keep tenants informed of any delays or scheduling changes.  

        Conduct follow-up communication after repairs to confirm work has been completed satisfactorily.  

        Maintain a high level of professionalism and customer service in all tenant interactions.  





Basic Maintenance Troubleshooting 

         Assist tenants in resolving simple maintenance issues remotely before dispatching a technician, when appropriate.  

         Provide clear, step-by-step guidance over the phone for basic troubleshooting tasks. 

         Help tenants with common maintenance issues such as:  

                   Resetting garbage disposals.  

                   Resetting tripped GFCI outlets.  

                   Identifying and flipping tripped circuit breakers.  

                   Replacing HVAC air filters.  

                   Check thermostat settings and batteries.  

                   Relighting pilot lights when appropriate and safe.  

                   Troubleshooting appliances using manufacturer-recommended reset procedures.  

                    Determine when an issue can be safely resolved remotely versus when an in-person technician is required.  

                    Educate tenants on basic maintenance practices that help prevent recurring issues.  



 

Pest Infestation Management 

       Receive, document, and assess tenant reports related to pest infestations, including rodents, insects, termites, bed bugs, and other pest concerns.  

       Determine the urgency of reported pest issues and prioritize cases based on severity.  

       Coordinate inspections and treatment appointments with licensed pest control vendors.  

       Schedule appointments with tenants and ensure access is available for inspections and treatments.  

       Track treatment schedules, follow-up visits, and completion status until the infestation has been fully resolved.  

       Maintain detailed records of infestation reports, treatments performed, vendor recommendations, and tenant communications.  

       Escalate recurring or severe issues to property management for further review and corrective action.  



 

Vendor Management 

        Coordinate with third-party vendors for specialized maintenance services and repairs.  

        Obtain quotes, compare service options, and schedule vendor appointments.  

        Communicate work requirements, property access instructions, and expected completion timelines.  

        Monitor vendor performance, quality of work, responsiveness, and completion times.  

        Maintain organized vendor records, service history, and contact information.  

Ensure vendor invoices and completed work are properly documented.  



 

Maintenance Operations 

         Monitor daily maintenance activities across assigned properties.  

          Track work order completion of metrics and identify overdue or stalled requests.  

          Assist in improving maintenance response times and operational efficiency.  

          Ensure maintenance requests are completed in accordance with company service standards.  

          Use practical maintenance knowledge to assess reported issues, identify likely causes, and recommend the most appropriate course of action.  

          Whenever possible, resolve minor maintenance concerns through remote troubleshooting before dispatching a technician. 

          Collaborate with property managers regarding maintenance priorities and recurring property issues.  

          Maintain accurate maintenance of documentation and operational records.  



 

Administrative Responsibilities 

          Update maintenance records within the property management system.  

          Maintain detailed logs for work orders, vendor activity, pest control services, inspections, and preventative maintenance.  

          Generate maintenance performance reports for management.  

          Track maintenance of KPIs, including response times, completion rates, outstanding work orders, and recurring issues.  

          Assist with developing and improving maintenance workflows and standard operating procedures.  

          Support other administrative tasks related to maintenance operations as assigned.  



 

Qualifications:

Required 

     Minimum of 2 years of experience in maintenance coordination, property management, facilities management, or related field.  

     Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.  

     Strong organizational, planning, and multitasking abilities.  

     Ability to prioritize competing maintenance requests in a fast-paced environment.  

     Strong customer service and conflict-resolution skills.  

     Ability to work independently while managing multiple deadlines.  

    High attention to detail and accuracy in documentation.  



Preferred

     Experience using Yardi, Microsoft Teams, Outlook, or similar property management software.  

     Experience coordinating maintenance technicians, contractors, and vendors.  

     Knowledge of residential property maintenance and repair processes.  

     Basic understanding of plumbing, electrical, HVAC, appliance repair, carpentry, and general maintenance terminology.  

     Experience working remotely within a property management environment.  

    Ability to identify common maintenance issues and guide tenants through safe, basic troubleshooting before scheduling a service visit. 



 

Skills & Competencies: 

      Maintenance Coordination  

      Work Order Management  

      Tenant Relations & Customer Service  

      Vendor & Contractor Management  

      Scheduling & Dispatching  

      Preventative Maintenance Planning  

      Property Management Systems (Yardi preferred)  

     Communication & Follow-Up  

     Time Management & Prioritization  

     Problem Solving & Decision Making  

     Documentation & Recordkeeping  

     Attention to Detail  

     Ability to Work Independently  

     Basic Residential Maintenance Troubleshooting

We are looking for highly experienced Transaction Coordinators who are go-getters, confident, and ready to jump into a team that closes deals every day and every month. This is not a laid-back role; this is not an entry-level role. This is an advanced Transaction Coordinator Role. 



Transaction Coordinator and Administrative Assistant, real estate investment company



Job description



We are a fast-growing real estate investment company operating in the Kansas City and Springfield, Missouri markets. Our business focuses on off market and wholesale acquisitions, fix and flip projects, new construction, and rental properties. We are looking for a detail oriented Transaction Coordinator who can also step into an Administrative Assistant role during slower periods. This is a part time position, working Monday through Friday, nine AM to one PM Central time.



You will be the backbone of our deal pipeline, making sure every off market and wholesale transaction moves smoothly from contract to close. You will work closely with title companies, escrow, sellers, buyers, and our internal team to keep files organized and deadlines on track. Responsibilities



Managing transaction files from executed contract through closing for wholesale and off market deals. Coordinating directly with title companies to open title, resolve title issues, and track closing timelines. Communicating proactively with sellers, buyers, title companies, and internal team members to keep everyone updated. Preparing, organizing, and reviewing contracts, disclosures, and closing documents for accuracy and completeness. Maintaining organized, up to date records in our CRM and transaction management systems. Flagging issues or delays early and helping resolve them before they become problems. Following established checklists, workflows, and standard operating procedures. During slower periods, providing administrative support such as data entry,
 management, scheduling, and document organization. Assisting with light bookkeeping tasks in QuickBooks, including data entry and reconciliation support. Working within Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Drive to maintain shared files and reports.



Requirements



Prior experience as a Transaction Coordinator, ideally with exposure to wholesale, off market, or investor real estate transactions. Strong understanding of the contract to close process and working with title companies. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. Strong technical skills and comfort learning new software and systems quickly. Experience with QuickBooks or general bookkeeping is a strong plus. Proficiency with Google Sheets, Google Docs, and Google Drive. Highly organized, detail oriented, and able to manage multiple files at once without dropping details. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. Available Monday through Friday, nine AM to one PM Central time. Having an Iphone is a plus.

title: PAID MEDIA EXECUTIVE - META, TIKTOK & SNAPCHAT - UK EVENTS BRAND (LONG-TERM)
description:
ABOUT US



We run Cocktail Week - city-wide cocktail festivals across more than 20 cities in the UK and Ireland, including Belfast, Liverpool, Manchester, Newcastle, Leeds, Cardiff, Dublin and Cork.



We sell wristbands that give people access to discounted cocktails across dozens of bars in their city. Paid social is how most of those tickets get sold.





IMPORTANT - PLEASE READ THIS PART CAREFULLY



This role is campaign BUILDING, QUALITY CONTROL and REPORTING. It is not a budget-owning role.



Our media buyer sets the strategy, d
 the budgets and makes the calls on where money goes. Your job is to build the campaigns to her specification, make sure everything is set up correctly before it goes live, monitor daily performance, and flag problems quickly.



You will not be setting or changing budgets, and you will not be launching campaigns without sign-off. If that sounds too restrictive, this is not the role for you. If you are happy owning execution and quality to a very high standard, please read on - there is room to grow into more over time.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



CAMPAIGN BUILDING

- Build campaigns across Meta, and later TikTok and Snapchat, following our specification

- Work across 20+ cities and four campaign phases, so there is a lot of repeated structure to get right

- Apply geographic targeting from our existing city radius spreadsheet

- Build creative testing structures from the video variants our content creator produces

- Keep to a strict naming convention across every platform



QUALITY CONTROL (this is the most important part of the job)

- Check that age targeting is set to 18+ on every single advert, every time. We advertise alcohol events and this is not optional.

- Confirm tracking and conversion events are firing before anything goes live

- Check radii, budgets and dates against the brief before launch

- Review creative against platform advertising rules and flag anything that might be rejected



MONITORING

- Daily check on spend pacing - is anything overspending, underspending, or stopped?

- Flag anything unusual to us the same day. Flag it, do not fix it yourself.

- Watch for rejected or restricted adverts and report them straight away



REPORTING

- Weekly performance reporting by city, platform and campaign phase

- Spend against budget, with early warning on pacing

- Creative performance, so our content team knows what is working

- Keep audience and asset libraries tidy





WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- Hands-on experience building campaigns in Meta Ads Manager. Not boosting posts - actually building campaigns, ad sets and adverts.

- Understanding of how conversion tracking and pixels work, and what it looks like when they are broken

- Extremely careful attention to detail. Most of this job is catching the thing that is set up wrong before it costs money.

- Comfortable with repetitive, structured work across many cities

- Able to explain performance simply in writing

- Willing to follow a specification exactly and flag concerns rather than make changes yourself





NICE TO HAVE (NOT REQUIRED)



- TikTok Ads Manager or Snapchat Ads Manager experience

- Experience with restricted or regulated advertising categories (alcohol, gambling, health)

- Google Analytics 4

- Experience with events, ticketing or hospitality

- Experience working to a media buyer's brief rather than setting strategy yourself





HOW TO APPLY



Please send us:



1. A short note (maximum 250 words) about the accounts you have worked on - platforms, roughly what monthly budget, and what you were responsible for.



2. Start your message with the word MEASURE so we know you have read this properly.



3. Answer this question in two or three sentences: how would you know if the conversion tracking on an advertising account was broken?



4. Your available hours and how much overlap you can give with UK morning time.



Shortlisted applicants will be given a paid trial task before we make any hiring decision. We pay for the trial regardless of the outcome.



We are looking for someone long-term who can grow with us as we add cities. If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

description:

Our company is developing a unique cartoon universe featuring original characters including FlyGuy, Princess Avrielle, Ashy, Mr. Foamy, and other characters that will be introduced as the brand continues to grow.



The goal is to create entertaining, funny, engaging and high-quality animated content that can be used across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram,
 and other digital platforms, while also supporting our events, educational programs, merchandise and overall brand development.



This is an exciting opportunity for someone who loves animation, storytelling, AI, cartoons, video production and social media and wants to help build an original entertainment brand from the ground up.



Key Responsibilities

1. AI Cartoon & Animation Production

Create character movements, expressions and interactions.

Produce short-form animated videos for social media.

Create promotional animated videos for our businesses and events.

Turn written concepts and scripts into finished animated videos.

Create scenes, backgrounds and environments that match the 2Fly Universe.

2. Character Consistency



Character consistency is extremely important for this position.



You will be responsible for helping ensure that our characters maintain:



Consistent appearance

Consistent clothing and accessories

Consistent colors

Consistent personalities

Consistent voices

Consistent animation style

Consistent visual quality



You will work from our established character references and creative direction.

STEM

Gaming

Education

Friendship

Family

Community

Events

Behind-the-scenes stories

Problem-solving

Positive behavior and teamwork



The creator should be able to take a simple idea such as:

and turn it into a complete short animated story with scenes, dialogue and action.



4. Short-Form Content

TikTok

Instagram Reels

 Reels

YouTube Shorts

Character introductions

Funny moments

Mini-stories

Memes

Promotional clips

Character challenges

Educational clips

Behind-the-scenes animation content

Storyboarding.

Creating scenes.

Editing animation.

Adding dialogue.

Adding sound effects.

Adding music.

Adding captions.

Creating thumbnails.

Preparing videos for upload.

Creating Shorts from longer episodes.



The long-term goal is to develop the 2Fly Universe into a recognizable animated entertainment brand.

The creator should be comfortable experimenting with and learning tools for:

AI animation

AI voice generation

AI music

AI sound effects

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location:  Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

•  Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

title: Social Media Manager / DM Messenger – Recruitment Partnerships
description:
Social Media Manager / DM Messenger – Recruitment Partnerships



**Location:** Remote

**Rate:** $4 USD per hour

**Bonus Structure:** Available once settled into the role, details to be confirmed

**Trial Period:** Yes

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM Sydney time, including a 1-hour unpaid lunch break



## About the Role



She Sells With Brooke is looking for a switched-on, highly organised **Social Media Manager / DM Messenger** to support our Head of Recruitment.



This role is focused on building genuine relationships with potential **business partners** through social media and direct messages.



You will be responsible for researching and identifying suitable businesses and business owners, starting conversations, building rapport, following up, and eventually booking qualified meetings with our Head of Recruitment.



This is similar to appointment setting, but the conversations are more relationship-focused and higher level. You will often be communicating directly with business owners and representing our Head of Recruitment through his social media accounts.



We are **not** looking for someone who sends generic, copy-and-paste messages or pushes people into meetings.



We need someone who understands how to communicate professionally while still sounding warm, natural and human.



## What You'll Be Doing



* Research and identify potential businesses and business partners to connect with

* Reach out to business owners through social media and DMs

* Start and maintain genuine, professional conversations

* Build rapport before moving conversations towards a potential meeting

* Communicate as the voice of our Head of Recruitment

* Understand the context and nuance of conversations rather than relying only on scripts

* Know when to continue a conversation, ask another question, follow up or suggest a meeting

* Book qualified meetings with our Head of Recruitment

* Keep track of conversations and potential partnerships

* Manage and update the outreach/pipeline accurately

* Follow up with people who haven't responded without sounding pushy or salesy

* Make sure important conversations don't get missed

* Flag opportunities, concerns or unusual situations to the team

* Help improve outreach and messaging processes as you become familiar with the role



## Who We're Looking For



We are looking for an **A-player** who is switched on, fast and able to think for themselves.



You should have:



* **Excellent written English**

* Strong spoken English

* World-class communication skills

* Previous experience with DMs, outreach, appointment setting, social media management or a similar role

* The ability to communicate professionally while still being warm and personable

* A strong understanding of conversational flow and tone

* The ability to recognize nuance and adjust your communication depending on the person you're speaking with

* Confidence communicating with business owners and professionals

* Strong attention to detail

* Good judgement and problem-solving skills

* Excellent follow-up and organization skills

* Experience managing conversations, contacts or pipelines

* The ability to work independently without needing every step explained

* A willingness to learn quickly and take feedback onboard

* A proactive attitude and strong work ethic



Experience with **Airtable, GoHighLevel or similar CRM/pipeline systems** would be an advantage.



## This Role Would Suit Someone Who...



* Enjoys talking to people and building relationships

* Can make a conversation feel natural rather than scripted

* Understands that good outreach is about connection, not just getting someone onto a call

* Can read between the lines and understand what someone really means

* Knows how to follow up without becoming annoying or pushy

* Is confident speaking with business owners

* Takes ownership when something needs attention

* Learns quickly and can hit the ground running

* Wants to grow with the role and be rewarded for strong performance



## Application Process



As communication is one of the most important parts of this role, please
 your application to 
 with the subject line:



**Recruitment DM Messenger Application**



Please include the following:



1. **Your resume**

2. **A short video introducing yourself** and answering:



   * Tell us about your previous experience with DMs, outreach, appointment setting or social media.

   * Have you communicated with business owners or professionals before? Tell us about it.

   * What do you think makes a DM conversation feel genuine rather than salesy?

   * Tell us about any experience you have managing a CRM, Airtable, GoHighLevel or a lead/relationship pipeline.

   * Why do you believe you would be an A-player in this role?



Please make your video specifically for this application rather than sending a generic introduction video.



## What We Offer



* **$4 USD per hour**

* Monday to Friday schedule, **8:30 AM to 5:30 PM Sydney time**

* **1-hour unpaid lunch break each day**

* Trial period before moving into the ongoing role

* Opportunity to earn **performance-based bonuses once settled into the position**

* Fully remote work

* Training and support from the She Sells team

* Opportunity to grow within a fast-moving business



This is not a role for someone looking to simply send a set number of copy-and-paste DMs each day.



We are looking for someone who takes pride in their communication, thinks critically, builds genuine relationships and wants to become excellent at what they do.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Competitive Advantage

title: YouTube Vlog Editor for Touring DJ / Music Artist - Long-Term
description:
I’m looking for a long-term YouTube vlog editor for JAMØ, a touring DJ and music artist.



These vlogs will document touring, making music, shows, career moments, everyday life, and candid time with friends. The goal is to make viewers feel like they’re genuinely hanging out with us—not watching a polished influencer vlog.



The editing style should feel authentic, organic, documentary-like, raw, intimate, funny, honest, and slightly imperfect. The focus is personality, relationships, storytelling, and comedic timing—not technical flash.



You should know when to keep an honest conversation, funny interaction, awkward moment, silence, or small detail that helps viewers understand the people and story. Most edits should use simple hard cuts. Music should be subtle, and original or ambient audio should remain the focus whenever possible.



Please do not use excessive zooms, flashy transitions, memes, unnecessary sound effects, animated graphics, or stereotypical fast-paced YouTube editing. The goal is not to make every second loud or optimized for retention.



A strong edit should have a natural beginning, middle, and end. An understated cold open from later in the footage is welcome when it creates genuine curiosity, but it should not feel like a dramatic trailer.



When selecting footage, ask: “Does this help the viewer understand JAMØ, his friends, his music, or his life better?” If not, it can probably be removed.



WHAT I’M LOOKING FOR

- Experience editing vlogs, documentary-style content, artist content, or personality-driven YouTube videos

- Excellent storytelling instincts and comedic timing

- Strong spoken-English comprehension

- Good judgment about when to cut and when to let a moment breathe

- Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times

- Ability to learn recurring people, jokes, music, and the overall JAMØ world

- Proficiency in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

- Interest in electronic music, touring, nightlife, or artist culture is a plus



TO APPLY

Begin your application with the word “ORGANIC.”



Please include:

1. Two or three relevant videos that you personally edited

2. A brief explanation of what you handled in each video

3. The editing software you use

4. Your usual turnaround time

5. Your desired hourly rate

6. A few sentences explaining how you would make a vlog feel authentic without making it boring



Do not create unpaid sample work.



PAID TEST

A small group of finalists will receive the same 60–90 seconds of raw footage and the same instructions. Each finalist will be paid for the test.



The test will be judged primarily on story selection, authenticity, comedic timing, pacing, restraint, music and audio choices, and the ability to make viewers feel present. Technical effects will not outweigh good taste and storytelling.

title: Seasonal Customer Service & Estimating Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Contract Position | October 1 – December 11, 2026 | 30–40 Hours/Week



ABOUT US



Knight’s Lights is a premium Christmas lighting company serving Northwest Arkansas. We design, install, maintain, remove, and store custom Christmas lighting for residential and commercial customers.



We also operate Knight Window Washing, a residential and commercial window cleaning company. Knight’s Lights will be the primary focus of this position during the holiday season, with Knight Window Washing administrative work filling slower periods.



This is a short-term seasonal position. We are looking for someone who is great with people, communicates extremely well, stays organized, and gets things done on time.



ABOUT THE ROLE



Your most important responsibility will be answering inbound calls and providing an excellent first impression of our company.



You will speak directly with U.S. homeowners, collect information about their Christmas lighting needs, answer routine questions, and help guide customers through our process.



After customer calls, you will also help determine whether we can prepare an estimate virtually or whether the property needs an in-person visit from the owner.



Most estimates will be completed virtually. You will be trained to use our Christmas lighting design software to create mockups, take measurements, prepare pricing, and build complete estimates for owner review.



During quieter periods, you will assist with scheduling, customer follow-up, CRM management, and simple administrative work for Knight’s Lights and Knight Window Washing.



SCHEDULE



Paid training will begin before October.



October 1 through December 11:



- Approximately 30–40 hours per week.

- Availability during U.S. Central Time business hours is required.

- This is a seasonal contract position expected to end around December 11, 2026.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION



- Answer inbound Knight’s Lights phone calls.

- Provide a friendly, professional first impression.

- Collect customer and property information.

- Qualify new leads.

- Answer routine customer questions.

- Respond to routine customer text and
 messages.

- Make scheduled follow-up calls to customers with open estimates.

- Escalate pricing, design, complaint, safety, damage, or unusual situations to the owner.



VIRTUAL ESTIMATING



- Review available property imagery after customer calls.

- Determine whether an estimate can be completed virtually using our documented process.

- Flag properties requiring an onsite estimate for the owner.

- Create customers and estimates in Housecall Pro.

- Learn and use Holiday Home Concepts Christmas lighting design software.

- Create lighting mockups.

- Measure rooflines and other decorating areas.

- Enter colors, footage, options, photos, specialties, and installation notes.

- Prepare polished estimates that are ready for owner review.

- Move completed estimates into our Ready for Review pipeline.



The owner will review and personally send estimates. You are not expected to make complicated pricing or sales decisions.



SCHEDULING AND CUSTOMER COORDINATION



- Monitor approved estimates and deposits.

- Schedule installations once the required deposit has been received.

- Follow our geographic scheduling and availability guidelines.

- Send and manage routine scheduling communication.

- Handle routine appointment changes.

- Receive customer repair or callback requests.

- Schedule routine repairs and track them until completed.

- Escalate urgent or unusual issues when necessary.



KNIGHT WINDOW WASHING SUPPORT



When Knight’s Lights work is caught up, you may assist our window cleaning business with:



- Customer follow-up calls.

- Scheduling.

- CRM updates.

- Accounts-receivable follow-up.

- Payroll preparation and basic data gathering.

- Scheduling prewritten social media posts.

- Organizing photos and files.

- Other documented, repeatable administrative tasks.



SOCIAL MEDIA



This is not a creative marketing position.



Content, captions, photos, and posting instructions will generally be provided to you. Your responsibility will be to correctly upload and schedule the provided content using social scheduling platforms such as Meta Business Suite or similar software.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is a people-person first.



You should:



- Genuinely enjoy talking with customers.

- Have excellent spoken and written English.

- Sound confident, friendly, and natural when speaking with U.S. customers.

- Have a strong professional phone presence.

- Be organized and detail-oriented.

- Complete tasks promptly without needing constant reminders.

- Be comfortable managing multiple priorities.

- Learn new software quickly.

- Be comfortable working independently after training.

- Know when to follow the process and when to ask for help.



Christmas lighting experience is NOT required.



We will train you on our estimating process, Holiday Home Concepts, Housecall Pro, scheduling procedures, customer policies, and internal systems.



SOFTWARE YOU MAY USE



- Housecall Pro

- Holiday Home Concepts

- Google Workspace

- Google Sheets

- Gmail

- Google Calendar

- Meta Business Suite or similar social scheduling software

- ChatGPT and/or Claude

- Zoom

- Loom



COMPENSATION



Hourly contract position.



Expected pay range: $11–$15/hour depending on experience and communication ability.



Our planned compensation structure is approximately:



- $12/hour during the initial training period.

- $13/hour after successful training and independent performance.

- $14/hour later in the season for candidates who demonstrate strong performance and reliability.

- Approximately 30–40 hours per week during the primary season.



HOW TO APPLY



IMPORTANT: Applications without a voice or video recording may not be reviewed.



In your written application or cover letter, please include:



1.  A brief introduction.

2.  A summary of your customer service and phone experience.

3.  Include the phrase “Blue Christmas” somewhere in your application so we know you read the entire posting.



In a 60–90 second video or voice recording introducing yourself. Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared script.



1. Tell us about a time you had multiple tasks or customers to keep track of at once.

2. Tell us about your experience learning new software or CRM systems.

3.  In your recording, please briefly pretend you are answering this customer: “Hi, I’m interested in getting Christmas lights installed on my house. How does your process work?”



We are primarily evaluating communication style, spoken English, friendliness, confidence, and phone presence.



Qualified applicants may be invited to a video interview, mock customer phone call, and short paid skills assessment.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



- Customers receive quick, friendly, professional service.

- Inbound calls are answered confidently.

- Customer information is accurate.

- Virtual estimates are prepared quickly and correctly.

- Follow-up happens on schedule.

- Customers who pay their deposits get scheduled promptly.

- Routine questions and requests are handled without unnecessary owner involvement.

- Most importantly, customers should feel like they are speaking with a knowledgeable member of our local company, not an outsourced call center.

REQUIREMENTS

title: Part-Time FMCG / CPG Bookkeeper & Inventory Operations Coordinator
description:
This is a part time (with potential to grow into full time after 3-6 months) role.



We are an Australian functional chocolate brand selling through Amazon, Shopify, retail, distributors and 3PL warehouses.



We are looking for an experienced bookkeeper with FMCG / CPG / physical-product experience to help us keep our financial and operational records exceptionally organised.



This is not a basic data-entry VA role.



We want someone who has already worked with inventory-based businesses and understands how purchase orders, supplier invoices, manufacturing, inventory, COGS, freight, 3PLs and stock movements fit together.



You should be able to bring this experience to us. We do not want to teach someone how a CPG supply chain works.



What you will own



Keep Xero accurate and up to date, including bills, supplier invoices, reconciliations and accounts payable.

Maintain clean records of purchase orders, invoices, production orders, freight and supplier documentation.

Ensure committed production and material purchases are documented before invoices arrive.

Help maintain accurate inventory and COGS across raw materials, packaging and finished goods.

Reconcile information across suppliers, co-manufacturers, 3PL warehouses, Amazon and Shopify where required.

Keep production, inventory and supplier files extremely well organised in Google Drive.

Maintain our inventory/operations records so stock receipts, production runs, purchase orders and stock movements are recorded correctly.

Work closely with our demand planner so she always has clean, reliable information for weekly production and purchasing decisions.

Proactively flag missing invoices, undocumented commitments, stock discrepancies or unusual costs.

Suggest better processes where you see opportunities to improve how we operate.



You must have



Previous experience with an FMCG, CPG, food, beverage, supplement, cosmetics or other inventory-heavy physical-product business.

Strong hands-on Xero experience.

Strong understanding of inventory accounting and COGS.

Experience with purchase orders, accounts payable and supplier reconciliation.

Experience dealing with 3PLs, warehouses, manufacturers or co-packers.

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Very high attention to detail and organisation.

Ability to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions.



Experience with Amazon Seller Central, Shopify and Australian GST/BAS is highly desirable.



Please do not apply if your bookkeeping experience has only been with service businesses.



Application instructions



Please answer the following questions in your application:



What FMCG / CPG / physical-product businesses have you worked with, and what did they sell?

Give one specific example of how you managed inventory, COGS, purchase orders and supplier invoices.

Have you worked with a 3PL, warehouse or contract manufacturer? What were you responsible for?

What have you personally done inside Xero?

Have you worked with Amazon Seller Central and/or Shopify?

If a production order has been approved but the supplier has not yet sent an invoice, how would you make sure the business still knows about the financial and inventory commitment?

What hourly rate are you looking for, and how many hours per week are you available?



Loom video required



Please include a 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and answering these two questions:



Tell us about the most relevant FMCG / CPG / inventory-based business you have worked with.

What would you focus on in your first 30 days to make sure our bookkeeping and operations records are extremely well organised?



Please speak naturally in the video. We use this to assess communication skills as well as experience.



Important screening instruction



In the subject line of your application, please include the answer to this question:



What is 17 + 8?



Your subject line must contain: CPG 25



Applications that do not include CPG 25 in the subject line will not be reviewed.
